items.zh_points: 麦迪逊今日晴朗有风，新一周伊始天气干燥温和，下半周气温将转凉。
items.en_points: Madison will be sunny and breezy today with temperatures turning cooler later in the week.

items.title: State Trooper released after ICE arrest at Airport
items.zh_title: 威州巡警因签证逾期在机场被捕后获释
items.zh_points: 一名威斯康星州巡警因涉嫌签证逾期在戴恩县机场被移民执法局逮捕，随后获释。
items.en_points: A Wisconsin State Trooper was arrested by ICE at Dane County Regional Airport for allegedly overstaying his visa and has been released.

items.title: Madison family calls on shooter to turn themselves in after deadly shooting on Regent Street
items.zh_title: 摄政街枪击案受害者家属呼吁凶手自首
items.zh_points: 麦迪逊摄政街发生致死枪击案，警方目前尚未抓获嫌疑人，受害者家属公开呼吁枪手自首。
items.en_points: Following a deadly shooting on Regent Street, no suspect is currently under arrest and the victim's family is urging the shooter to surrender.

items.title: Madison police investigating death near Langdon Street
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊警方调查兰登街死亡事件
items.zh_points: 麦迪逊警方周六晚间在校园附近的兰登街区域调查一起人员死亡案件，现场调查仍在进行。
items.en_points: Madison police are actively investigating a death in the Langdon Street area near campus following a Saturday evening call.

items.title: The ‘blue wave’ hits Wisconsin: Democrats take control of the legislature, maintain governor’s seat
items.zh_title: 民主党赢得威州议会控制权并保住州长
items.zh_points: 威斯康星州中期选举中民主党18年来首次同时赢得州议会两院多数，克劳利当选州长。
items.en_points: Wisconsin Democrats won majorities in both legislative chambers for the first time in 18 years, alongside David Crowley's gubernatorial victory.

items.title: UW–Madison chancellor special regent committee announces three finalists
items.zh_title: 威斯康星大学新任校长公布三位候选人
items.zh_points: 校董会特别委员会公布威大新任校长三位最终候选人名单，候选人公开论坛将于下周在校园举行。
items.en_points: The Special Regent Committee announced three finalists for the UW–Madison chancellor position, with campus forums scheduled for next week.

items.title: Peer Support Drop-In Hours w/ Badger Supports

items.title: RCC Drop-in Hours
items.zh_title: 强奸危机中心在大学图书馆设咨询点

items.en_points: RCC hosts drop-in hours in Helen C. White Hall and online, providing confidential advocacy and resources regarding sexual violence.

items.title: CDC identifies 4 drug-resistant germs that pose an 'urgent threat'
items.zh_title: CDC列出四种具紧迫威胁耐药病菌
items.zh_points: 美疾控中心将四种耐药细菌列为紧迫健康威胁，提醒公众警惕感染风险。
items.en_points: The CDC identified four drug-resistant germs as urgent threats to public health.

items.title: Unpaid hospital care climbs across Wisconsin, topping $2 billion
items.zh_title: 威州未付医疗费用总额超20亿美元
items.zh_points: 报告显示威斯康星州未付医疗费用超过20亿美元，其中戴恩县医院占超2.92亿美元。
items.en_points: Unpaid hospital care in Wisconsin exceeded $2 billion, with Dane County hospitals reporting over $292 million in charity care and bad debt.

items.title: From cell to organoid, Madison companies advance new models of the brain
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊生物企业推进脑类器官模型研究
items.zh_points: 麦迪逊本地生物科技企业研发模拟脑部组织的细胞类器官，助力神经系统疾病与药物研发。
items.en_points: Madison biotech companies are developing brain organoids that mimic brain tissue, aiding neurological disease research and treatment testing.

items.title: Mickies Dairy Bar fans await next chapter for game-day staple
items.zh_title: 坎普兰德尔旁老牌餐厅换主待重开

items.en_points: Mickies Dairy Bar, a nearly 80-year-old landmark near Camp Randall Stadium, has been closed since July as fans await its reopening under new ownership.

items.title: Donations begin early at Badger Bash for WMTV’s Share Your Holidays campaign
items.zh_title: 假日募捐活动支持UW学生食品救济处

items.en_points: Donations gathered at Union South will support UW–Madison's student-run Open Seat Food Pantry, with a sponsor matching up to $5,000.

items.title: Music beyond the major: Opportunities at UW
items.zh_title: 威大为非音乐专业学生提供丰富音乐活动
items.zh_points: 威斯康星大学为非音乐专业学生提供多种参与音乐创作与社团演出的途径，可通过学生活动平台了解。
items.en_points: UW–Madison offers diverse musical opportunities and student groups for non-music majors looking to continue their musical passions.

items.title: How to Ace Exam Week 101

items.en_points: An International Student Services student employee shares practical study strategies and advice for navigating midterms and final exams.

items.title: The cost of opportunity: federal student loan policy and gender inequality

items.zh_points: 评论文章探讨联邦新法案对助学贷款的影响，新政计划于2027年限制部分低薪资专业的贷款资格。
items.en_points: An opinion piece examines federal student loan policy changes set for 2027 that could restrict college loans for certain fields of study.

items.title: Hope for the critically endangered northern muriqui monkey

items.en_points: A UW–Madison researcher received a $1 million five-year grant to lead conservation efforts for Brazil's critically endangered northern muriqui monkeys.

items.title: Madison’s ADA Transition Plan, progress so far

items.title: Beyond screening: How a UW study revealed persistent racial disparities in Wisconsin cervical cancer rates

items.title: Exploring Teaching Careers at Teaching Intensive Universities Learn about teaching faculty careers in this online panel of CIRTL alumni who teach at liberal arts colleges and universities.

items.title: Mt. Mendota Top Rope Belay Clinic

items.en_points: The Madison Polish Film Festival hosts a free screening of the Polish film Altar Boys, organized by the Polish Student Association.

items.title: Volleyball: UW vs. Penn State

items.title: Early Fall Migrating Birds Nature Walk with the Friends of the Lakeshore Nature Preserve

items.title: Midwest Minutes: Four things to do around Wisconsin (Nov. 8-Nov. 15)

items.title: Mad City Gobblers continue tradition providing Thanksgiving turkeys to local food pantries

items.title: What is the value of an education in the arts?

items.title: Sunshine Returns for the Weekend

items.title: Key dates following Tuesday’s election

items.title: 19 great ideas for your Madison-area weekend

items.en_points: Friends of the Lakeshore Nature Preserve host a free poetry nature walk this afternoon starting at Picnic Point.

items.en_points: The Arboretum hosts a guided historical hike exploring remnants of the 1920s planned Lake Forest development.

items.title: Mustard Museum celebrates 40 years of collection
items.zh_title: 芥末博物馆庆祝建馆40周年
items.zh_points: 位于麦迪逊周边米德尔顿的芥末博物馆迎来40周年藏品纪念。
items.en_points: The National Mustard Museum celebrates 40 years of its condiment collection.

items.title: National peace walk comes to the Madison area
items.zh_title: 全美和平徒步活动途经麦迪逊
items.zh_points: 全美和平徒步活动本周末抵达麦迪逊地区，倡导社区和平理念。
items.en_points: The National Peace Walk passes through the Madison area to promote peace.

items.zh_points: 全州科学节 10/15–10/25 举行，55 个以上县有数百场科学、艺术与科技活动；可在 wiscifest.org 查找场次。
items.en_points: The statewide Wisconsin Science Festival runs Oct 15–25 with hundreds of science, art and tech events in 55+ counties; browse them at wiscifest.org.

items.en_points: Brewers vs. Rays World Series Game 2 shows tonight 7–9 p.m. on big screens at The Sett (Union South) and the Rathskeller (Memorial Union).

items.en_points: The Badgers host USC at Camp Randall Stadium tonight at 6:30 p.m.; ticket info is on uwbadgers.com.

items.title: RCC Drop-in Hours

items.en_points: Talk with an RCC advocate about sexual violence or campus resources, 6–9 p.m. tonight in 2191D College Library or via Zoom.

items.title: Staying Dry and Mild Through the Weekend
items.zh_title: 周末干燥温和，最高约 22°C
items.zh_points: 今明两天最高温华氏 70 度出头（约 21–23°C），云量增多；下周初回到常年气温，下周到万圣节周末偶有降雨。
items.en_points: Highs in the low 70s today and Sunday with more clouds; temperatures return closer to average early next week, with a few rain chances into Halloween weekend.

items.title: UW–Madison celebrates Nobel Prize winner Francis Halzen with fireside chat
items.zh_title: UW 为诺奖得主 Halzen 举办炉边对话
items.zh_points: UW–Madison 举办炉边对话庆祝物理学家 Francis Halzen 获诺贝尔奖，Halzen 在会上谈及获奖。
items.en_points: UW–Madison held a fireside chat celebrating physicist Francis Halzen, who talked about his Nobel Prize.

items.title: UWPD says pig CO2-stunning video claimed to be recorded on campus appears fabricated
items.zh_title: UWPD：校内猪只 CO2 致晕视频疑为伪造
items.zh_points: 一名 UW 近期毕业生称偷拍了肉类科学大楼内猪只 CO2 致晕过程；UWPD 审查后称视频似用公开素材伪造。
items.en_points: A recent UW grad claimed he secretly filmed pigs being CO2-stunned in the Meat Science building; UWPD says the video appears fabricated from public footage.

items.title: Madison Mayor Rhodes-Conway will not seek reelection, cites threats and safety concerns
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊市长 Rhodes-Conway 放弃连任
items.zh_points: 市长 Satya Rhodes-Conway 宣布不参加 4 月的连任选举，理由是遭受威胁、骚扰并担心人身安全；麦迪逊将迎来新市长。
items.en_points: Mayor Satya Rhodes-Conway will not seek reelection in April, citing threats, harassment and personal safety concerns; Madison will get a new mayor.

items.title: Q&A: IceCube collaborator Justin Vandenbrouke discusses award-winning research following UW professor Nobel Prize
items.zh_title: IceCube 合作者谈 Halzen 诺奖研究
items.zh_points: Badger Herald 专访物理教授 Justin Vandenbrouke，讲解中微子是什么、南极 IceCube 天文台为何具突破性。
items.en_points: The Badger Herald interviews IceCube physicist Justin Vandenbrouke on what neutrinos are and why the South Pole observatory behind Halzen's Nobel was revolutionary.

items.title: Nature Explorers - Join the WiSciFest BioBlitz Unleash your curiosity with the 2026 Wisconsin Science Festival BioBlitz
items.zh_title: 科学节 BioBlitz：上传自然观察
items.zh_points: 科学节期间举办 10 天全州生物调查（BioBlitz），在 iNaturalist 项目中上传自然观察即可参与。
items.en_points: A 10-day statewide BioBlitz runs during the Science Festival; take part by sharing nature observations in the iNaturalist project.

items.en_points: WUD Film screens Greta Gerwig's Lady Bird (2017, 95 min, rated R) tonight at 9 p.m.

items.en_points: Interactive play in which the audience helps decide a public trial. Shows at 2 and 7:30 p.m. today in Mitchell, Vilas Hall; tickets $12–$30.

items.en_points: UW Cinematheque screens the 1990 neo-noir After Dark, My Sweet (dir. James Foley) on 35mm tonight at 7 p.m. in 4070 Vilas Hall. Free.

items.zh_points: WUD Film 今晚 6 点放映詹姆斯·卡梅隆的《终结者 2：审判日》（1991，153 分钟，R 级）。
items.en_points: WUD Film screens James Cameron's Terminator 2: Judgment Day (1991, 153 min, rated R) tonight at 6 p.m.

items.zh_title: 植物园满月夜行，报名已截止
items.zh_points: 今天 17:30–19:00 植物园有向导带领的满月夜行，免费，但 Eventbrite 报名已于 10/20 截止。
items.en_points: Free naturalist-led full moon walk at the Arboretum, 5:30–7 p.m.; Eventbrite registration closed Oct 20. Wear sturdy closed-toe shoes.

items.title: Wisconsin vs. USC - 0.0 Tailgate

items.title: Badger Bash: Wisconsin vs. USC

items.en_points: Badger Bash at Union South starts 2.5 hours before kickoff of every home game, with food, drinks, the Badger Band and free goodies on Orchard Street.

items.title: TSA won't care it's Halloween. You can't travel with these things
items.zh_title: 万圣节坐飞机：部分物品不能过安检
items.zh_points: TSA 不会因万圣节放宽规定，有些东西不能带上飞机；扮装最好等过了安检再换。
items.en_points: TSA rules don't relax for Halloween; some items can't fly with you, so save the costume until you're past airport security.

items.title: Data center anxiety plays out in Senate campaign debates
items.zh_title: 数据中心议题进入参议院竞选辩论
items.zh_points: 民主党在参议院竞选辩论中把数据中心与能源成本上涨、生活负担挂钩，民调显示这一策略有支持。
items.en_points: In Senate campaign debates, Democrats tied data centers to rising energy costs and affordability, a choice polling appears to support.

items.title: Consumer sentiment near record low in US
items.zh_title: 美国消费者信心接近历史低点
items.zh_points: 调查显示 10 月美国消费者信心接近历史最低，中东冲突推高物价，家庭对经济更悲观。
items.en_points: US consumer sentiment edged to near a record low in October as prices pushed up by the Middle East conflict soured households' view of the economy.

items.title: 12 of the top cases on the US Supreme Court's docket this term
items.zh_title: 美国最高法院本期重点案件
items.zh_points: 最高法院本期（约九个月）将审理家庭自酿烈酒禁令、DOGE、投票权等案件，文章盘点其中 12 起。
items.en_points: A look at 12 major cases in the Supreme Court's nine-month term, from a ban on home distilling to DOGE and voting rights.

items.title: Westbound lanes on US 12 back open after closing due to crash
items.zh_title: US 12 西行车祸后已恢复通行
items.zh_points: 周五晚 8:30 后 US 12 近 Todd Drive 发生车祸，西行车道一度封闭，现已全部重开，中央隔离带仍关闭。
items.en_points: All westbound US 12 lanes near Todd Drive reopened after a crash just after 8:30 p.m. Friday; the median remains closed.

items.title: Men's Club Ice Hockey vs. Oakland
items.zh_title: 男子冰球俱乐部对阵 Oakland
items.zh_points: 威斯康星男子冰球俱乐部今天 15:30–19:15 在 Bakke 中心 Sub-Zero 冰场迎战 Oakland。
items.en_points: The men's Ice Hockey Club plays Oakland, 3:30–7:15 p.m. at the Sub-Zero Ice Center in the Bakke Recreation & Wellbeing Center.

items.zh_points: 学生助学金办公室今日中午12点至下午2点在Agricultural Hall 25室协助填报联邦助学金并答疑，现场提供午餐。
items.en_points: The Office of Student Financial Aid hosts an in-person session today from noon to 2 p.m. in Agricultural Hall room 25 to help students with FAFSA.

items.title: Early voting at Memorial Union, including same-day voter registration Early voting is formally known as in-person absentee voting in Wisconsin
items.zh_title: Memorial Union提供提前投票与现场选民登记
items.zh_points: 威州选民即日起可在Memorial Union二楼休息室进行提前投票并办理现场登记，今日开放时间为上午11点半至下午5点半。
items.en_points: Eligible voters can cast early ballots and register on-site today from 11:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. in the Memorial Union 2nd floor Main Lounge.

items.title: Mild, Cloudy Weekend Weather
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊周末天气温和干燥下周将迎降温
items.zh_points: 威斯康星中南部本周末气温持续高于平均水平且保持干燥，但云量逐渐增多，下周初将迎来显著降温。
items.en_points: Mild, dry weather above average temperatures will continue through Sunday in the Madison area before a significant cooldown arrives next week.

items.title: State commission approves nearly 1,700 new UW–Madison student beds as enrollment hits record high
items.zh_title: 威州建委会批准UW增建1700张学生床位
items.zh_points: 州建筑委员会批准新建两栋学生宿舍及400座食堂，预计2029年秋季投入使用，将增加近1700张床位以缓解住房紧张。
items.en_points: The State Building Commission approved plans for two new UW residence halls and a 400-seat dining hall by fall 2029, adding nearly 1,700 beds.

items.title: Study Abroad 101 Virtual Info Session
items.zh_title: 留学规划线上说明会
items.zh_points: 线上说明会于今日中午12点至下午1点举行，介绍海外学习基础、选项目、奖学金申请及实习科研机会。
items.en_points: A virtual info session on study abroad basics, funding, and internships will be held today from noon to 1 p.m. via Zoom.

items.title: Open Inquiry at UW–Madison The Faculty Survey in Conversation
items.zh_title: UW探讨学术自由与教职员工调查
items.zh_points: 教务长与法学院院长等校领导今日在Grainger Hall举行座谈，结合最新教职员工调查探讨UW的学术自由与言论表达。
items.en_points: UW Provost John Zumbrunnen and university leaders host a panel today in Grainger Hall discussing academic freedom and the faculty survey.

items.title: Next Wisconsin governor could replace scores of unconfirmed appointees
items.zh_title: 威州下任州长或撤换大量未获确认官员
items.zh_points: 由于州参议院未予确认，现任州长Evers提名的数百名关键委员会人选面临不确定性，11月选举后州政机构可能重组。
items.en_points: Hundreds of Gov. Tony Evers' unconfirmed appointees remain vulnerable to replacement by the next governor following the November election.

items.title: UW Health hosts 24th annual Fall Cancer Conference
items.zh_title: UW Health举办第24届秋季癌症大会
items.zh_points: UW Carbone癌症中心在Monona Terrace举行年度癌症大会，汇聚全州医护人员与康复者，探讨病后心理与身体康复。
items.en_points: The UW Carbone Cancer Center welcomed healthcare workers and survivors to Monona Terrace for its 24th annual Fall Cancer Conference.

items.title: USPS raises some shipping rates ahead of holiday season
items.zh_title: 美邮政假日季临时上调部分包裹运费
items.zh_points: 美国邮政自10月4日起至明年1月中旬，对Priority Mail和Ground Advantage等包裹实施季节性提价，以应对假日高峰运输成本。
items.en_points: The U.S. Postal Service has temporarily raised rates on Priority Mail and Ground Advantage package shipments through mid-January for the holiday season.

items.title: Using archival data for climate change: How historical cards show changes in freshwater fish
items.zh_title: 密歇根学者在UW研讨会分享五大湖鱼类研究
items.zh_points: 密歇根大学副教授Karen Alofs在生态与环境中心秋季研讨会发表演讲，指出五大湖水温自1951年以来已升高1.3摄氏度。
items.en_points: University of Michigan professor Karen Alofs presented historical research at UW showing Great Lakes temperatures rose 1.3 degrees Celsius since 1951.

items.title: Francesca Hong meets UW students at rally, discusses abortion rights ahead of election
items.zh_title: 州议员在Library Mall集会鼓励学生投票
items.zh_points: 威州众议员Francesca Hong等人在Library Mall与学生集会交流，围绕11月3日州长选举探讨投票与生殖健康议题。
items.en_points: State Rep. Francesca Hong and speakers met UW students at Library Mall on Oct. 22 to rally voter turnout ahead of the Nov. 3 election.

items.title: Michael Barbaro speaks on challenges of reporting on an increasingly polarized U.S.
items.zh_title: 纽约时报主播Barbaro在UW探讨媒体两极化
items.zh_points: 《纽约时报》播客主播Michael Barbaro在UW拉福莱特学院演讲，探讨政治极化与公众信任缺失对当代新闻报道的挑战。
items.en_points: NYT "The Daily" host Michael Barbaro spoke at UW's La Follette School about navigating political polarization and public distrust in media.

items.title: UW researchers share their contributions to revolutionary optogenetics field
items.zh_title: UW学者介绍在光遗传学领域的开创性研究
items.zh_points: 随着光遗传学开拓者荣获诺贝尔生理学或医学奖，UW研究人员分享了校园内利用光控神经元技术开展的前沿探索。
items.en_points: Following the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for optogenetics, UW researchers highlighted campus efforts using light to control neurons.

items.title: City of Madison Common Council votes to terminate Interim Independent Police Monitor Glass appointment five months early
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊市议会表决提前解雇临时独立警察监督员
items.zh_points: 麦迪逊市议会经多轮公众质询后以14比6的投票结果，决定立即终止临时独立警察监督员Aeiramique Glass的任期。
items.en_points: The Madison Common Council voted 14-6 to immediately terminate Interim Independent Police Monitor Aeiramique Glass after extended public comment.

items.title: UW-CTRI looks to utilize $11.1 million grant to further tobacco treatment
items.zh_title: UW控烟研究中心获1110万美元资助
items.zh_points: UW烟草研究与干预中心获得美国国家癌症研究所1110万美元资助，用于改进威州及麻州社区卫生中心的戒烟干预方案。
items.en_points: The UW Center for Tobacco Research and Intervention received an $11.1 million grant from the NCI to improve tobacco cessation at community clinics.

items.title: The 16th annual Wisconsin Science Festival is upon us: Here’s what it holds
items.zh_title: 第16届威斯康星科学节持续举办中
items.zh_points: 为期10天的威斯康星科学节持续至10月25日，全州各地举办丰富科普活动，鼓励民众近距离感受科学魅力。
items.en_points: The 16th annual Wisconsin Science Festival runs through Oct. 25, offering 10 days of community science events across the state.

items.en_points: The seminar on pro-unipotent completion and Tannakian formalism meets at 1 p.m. today in B309 Van Vleck Hall.

items.title: Pronouns Lunch N' Learn

items.en_points: A discussion on gender expression and pronouns takes place today from noon to 1 p.m. in Red Gym room 137, with lunch provided.

items.title: Money Magic: Read Aloud with Quentin and Quinlan

items.en_points: Quentin and Quinlan Riser will read from their book on financial literacy today from noon to 12:45 p.m. at Nancy Nicholas Hall.

items.title: Geospatial Data Science Speaker Series: Dr. Peng Luo How to Trust Your Imperfect GeoAI Model
items.zh_title: 地理数据科学讲座：不完美GeoAI模型

items.en_points: Dr. Peng Luo from the University of Iowa speaks today in 3310 Computer Sciences on uncertainty quantification in GeoAI models.

items.en_points: Dr. Nina Caputo speaks today at noon in 3138 Levy Hall on medieval Jewish disputes between traditionalists and rationalists.

items.title: Craft Your Own Heirloom: Wet-Felted Holiday Stocking Workshop
items.zh_title: 手工羊毛湿毡节日长袜工坊
items.zh_points: 校园手作工坊今日教授古老湿毡工艺，参与者可亲手制作羊毛节日装饰袜，了解毛纤维历史。
items.en_points: A hands-on wet felting workshop teaches students how to create durable wool holiday stockings from scratch.

items.title: Dams built across Starkweather Creek could be removed, along with the beavers who made them
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊计划拆除溪流海狸水坝防洪
items.zh_points: 麦迪逊市工程师计划于明年春季拆除Starkweather溪上的海狸水坝并迁移海狸，以消除周边洪水隐患。
items.en_points: City of Madison engineers plan to remove a beaver dam on Starkweather Creek next spring due to flooding concerns.

items.title: Breese Stevens to host World Series watch party Saturday
items.zh_title: Breese Stevens周六举办世界大赛观赛派对
items.zh_points: 麦迪逊Breese Stevens球场将于周六举办观赛派对，庆祝密尔沃基酿酒人队自1982年以来首次打入世界大赛。
items.en_points: Breese Stevens Field in Madison will host a World Series watch party on Saturday as the Brewers make their first appearance since 1982.

items.title: SoHE 1903 Graduate Research Scholars - Overview of Programming
items.zh_title: 人类生态学院研究生学者项目说明会
items.zh_points: SoHE研究生学者项目于今日上午11点半至下午1点在Nancy Nicholas Hall五楼举行项目概览，现场提供午餐。
items.en_points: An overview of the SoHE 1903 Graduate Research Scholars program takes place today from 11:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. in Nancy Nicholas Hall, with lunch provided.

items.title: Columbia County will start broadcasting meetings online
items.zh_title: 哥伦比亚县政府会议将上线直播
items.zh_points: 哥伦比亚县计划从11月起在Teams和YouTube平台发布政府公开会议视频，提升政务透明度。
items.en_points: Columbia County plans to begin posting its government meetings on Teams and YouTube starting in November.

items.title: Halloween Cookies & Snack Mix Making
items.zh_title: 麦当劳之家万圣节点心志愿制作活动
items.zh_points: 威斯康星Union志愿者今日上午11点15分至下午2点半在麦当劳之家为入住家庭制作饼干与点心，需提前报名确认。
items.en_points: Students can volunteer today from 11:15 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. at Ronald McDonald House Charities to make Halloween treats for families.

items.title: The 10 most affordable metros for living alone
items.zh_title: 全美单人独居租房负担城市榜单出炉
items.zh_points: 报告显示奥斯汀为全美独居最可负担城市，租金占收入23.1%；纽约租金负担最高达52%。
items.en_points: A report ranks Austin as the most affordable U.S. metro for living alone with rent at 23.1% of income, while New York ranks most expensive at 52%.

items.title: Madison doctor delivers handmade hats to newborn babies
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊医生为新生儿手织毛线帽
items.zh_points: 麦迪逊Meriter医院妇产科医生Erin Schoenecker执业25年来接生约5000名婴儿，并亲手为每名新生儿织帽作为纪念。
items.en_points: Dr. Erin Schoenecker at Madison's Meriter Hospital has delivered an estimated 5,000 babies over her 25-year career, giving each a handmade hat.

items.title: Stop stitching gender into our clothes
items.zh_title: Badger Herald专栏探讨服饰性别标签
items.zh_points: Badger Herald观点专栏反思现代服装中的性别界限，回顾17世纪前男女服饰历史，呼吁打破着装刻板印象。
items.en_points: A Badger Herald opinion column argues against strict gender categories in modern clothing, noting shared historical fashion practices.

items.title: From UW–Madison to the World Series
items.zh_title: UW校友助力酿酒人队进军世界大赛
items.zh_points: UW新闻报道多位威大校友在密尔沃基酿酒人队担任高管、营销人员、软件工程师及摄像师，为球队提供后台支持。
items.en_points: UW-Madison alumni serve across the Milwaukee Brewers organization as executives, marketers, and software engineers behind the pennant win.

items.title: UW-Madison sets discussion with Nobel Prize winner. You can attend
items.zh_title: UW举办诺奖得主Halzen公开对谈
items.zh_points: Francis Halzen因在南极一英里多深冰层下探测来自深空的高能中微子获诺贝尔奖，UW将举办与他的座谈，公众可参加；时间地点见原文。
items.en_points: UW-Madison has set a public discussion with Nobel laureate Francis Halzen, honored for detecting deep-space neutrinos under Antarctic ice; you can attend.

items.title: Gubernatorial debate highlights affordability for Wisconsinites
items.zh_title: 威州州长候选人举行唯一一场辩论
items.zh_points: 民主党Crowley与共和党Tiffany在11月3日大选前唯一一场辩论中，围绕税制与生活成本、K-12教育、数据中心等议题交锋；有投票资格的学生可作参考。
items.en_points: Democrat David Crowley and Republican Tom Tiffany met in their only debate before the Nov. 3 election, clashing on taxes, affordability, K-12 schools and data centers.

items.title: Early voting at Memorial Union, including same-day voter registration Early voting is formally known as in-person absentee voting in Wisconsin
items.zh_title: Memorial Union提前投票，可现场登记
items.zh_points: 威州选民11:30-17:30可在Memorial Union二楼主休息厅现场登记或重新登记，并当场完成投票。
items.en_points: Wisconsin voters can register or re-register and cast an early ballot in the Memorial Union Main Lounge (2nd floor), 11:30 a.m.-5:30 p.m.

items.title: Early voting at Union South, including same-day voter registration Early voting is formally known as in-person absentee voting in Wisconsin
items.zh_title: Union South提前投票，可现场登记
items.zh_points: 威州选民11:00-17:00可在Union South的Governance & Alumni Rooms现场登记并提前投票。
items.en_points: Wisconsin voters can register and vote early in the Governance & Alumni Rooms at Union South, 11 a.m.-5 p.m.

items.title: Intern Abroad with Sage Corps Resource Table
items.zh_title: Sage Corps海外暑期实习咨询摊位
items.zh_points: Sage Corps提供西班牙、荷兰、葡萄牙暑期实习，各专业可申请并可获学分；10:30-13:00在Memorial Union可与IAP工作人员当面咨询。
items.en_points: Sage Corps offers summer internships in Spain, the Netherlands and Portugal for all majors, with academic credit; meet staff at Memorial Union, 10:30 a.m.-1 p.m.

items.title: Another mild afternoon with seasonable temperatures ahead
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊继续晴暖，气温高于常年约20°F
items.zh_points: 今天继续晴朗，最高气温比常年高约20°F；之后气温将回到季节常态，出门注意按天增减衣物。
items.en_points: More sunshine today pushes highs about 20 degrees above average, with more seasonable temperatures ahead.

items.title: RCC Sexual Violence Resource Center receives donations following Cornell sexual assault case
items.zh_title: RCC性暴力资源中心收到数十笔新捐赠
items.zh_points: 康奈尔大学性侵案后，为幸存者提供服务的Dane County非营利机构RCC获社区数十笔新捐赠；如需帮助，可通过UHS了解校内支持渠道。
items.en_points: The RCC Sexual Violence Resource Center, a Dane County nonprofit for survivors, received dozens of donations after the Cornell case; UHS lists campus support options.

items.title: The Price of Publishing: A Conversation on Open Access Costs
items.zh_title: Steenbock图书馆座谈开放获取出版成本
items.zh_points: 研究人员与图书馆员13:00-14:00在Steenbock图书馆STEM Commons 126室讨论开放学术与出版费用上涨，适合关注论文发表的研究生。
items.en_points: Researchers and librarians discuss rising open-access publishing costs and open scholarship, 1-2 p.m. in STEM Commons Room 126, Steenbock Library.

items.title: Statistics Seminar Elizabeth Tipton: Designing for Prediction: What Out-of-Sample R² Should We Expect?
items.zh_title: 统计系讲座：预测模型的样本外R²
items.zh_points: Elizabeth Tipton 13:00在Morgridge Hall 7560室讲解如何依据样本量、预测变量和研究设计估算样本外R²，适合统计与社科方向学生。
items.en_points: Elizabeth Tipton presents formulas for estimating out-of-sample R² from sample size, predictors and study design; 1 p.m., 7560 Morgridge Hall.

items.title: WADC Day – Exploring the Wisconsin Administrative Data Core Institute for Research on Poverty Seminar
items.zh_title: 贫困研究所介绍威州行政数据库WADC
items.zh_points: IRP 12:15在Sewell大楼8417室介绍WADC：整合16类公共福利、教育、医疗和司法项目的行政数据，含最新数据发布与立项指导，适合做政策研究的学生。
items.en_points: IRP introduces the Wisconsin Administrative Data Core (data from 16 benefit, education, health and justice programs) and how to start a project; 8417 Sewell.

items.title: NACHP Distinguished Lecture Series Featuring Arlene Brown (Bishop Paiute Tribe) The Role of Community in Recovery: Reclaiming Indigenous Healing, Connection, and Hope
items.zh_title: 原住民健康讲座：社区在戒瘾康复中的作用
items.zh_points: Bishop Paiute部落的Arlene Brown 11:30在健康科学学习中心1335室分享原住民主导的戒瘾康复经验，也可线上参加，面向未来医疗从业者。
items.en_points: Arlene Brown (Bishop Paiute Tribe) discusses Indigenous-led addiction recovery and community healing; 11:30 a.m., 1335 Health Sciences Learning Center, also online.

items.title: Early voting at School of Nursing, including same-day voter registration Early voting is formally known as in-person absentee voting in Wisconsin
items.zh_title: 护理学院Cooper Hall设提前投票点
items.zh_points: 护理学院Signe Skott Cooper Hall中庭11:00-17:00提供提前投票和现场选民登记。
items.en_points: The Signe Skott Cooper Hall atrium (School of Nursing) offers early voting with same-day registration, 11 a.m.-5 p.m.

items.title: Early voting at School of Human Ecology, including same-day voter registration Early voting is formally known as in-person absentee voting in Wisconsin
items.zh_title: Nancy Nicholas Hall设提前投票点
items.zh_points: 人类生态学院Nancy Nicholas Hall正门11:00-17:00提供提前投票和现场选民登记。
items.en_points: Nancy Nicholas Hall's main entrance (School of Human Ecology) hosts early voting with same-day registration, 11 a.m.-5 p.m.

items.title: AI in Academia Coffee Hour: How do we evaluate student learning?
items.zh_title: AI学术咖啡时间：如何评估学生学习
items.zh_points: 11:00-12:00在Steenbock图书馆STEM Commons 126室讨论AI时代的作业与考核设计，以及学生如何理性选择使用AI。
items.en_points: A discussion on assessment and assignments in the age of AI, and how students can make informed choices about AI use; 11 a.m.-noon, STEM Commons, Steenbock Library.

items.title: AgileLog: A Forkable Shared Log for Agents Acting on Streaming Data Ram Alagappan (UIUC)
items.zh_title: CS讲座：面向流数据智能体的可分叉日志
items.zh_points: UIUC的Ram Alagappan 11:00-12:15在Morgridge Hall 2522室介绍AgileLog，也可Zoom线上参加，适合系统方向学生。
items.en_points: Ram Alagappan (UIUC) presents AgileLog, a forkable shared log for agents on streaming data; 11 a.m.-12:15 p.m., 2522 Morgridge Hall and on Zoom.

items.title: In Tandem: David Lynch & Christina A. West
items.zh_title: 展览In Tandem：Lynch版画与West雕塑
items.zh_points: 展览将Christina A. West的男性裸体陶塑与David Lynch由Tandem Press出版的照相凹版画并置，探讨身体与观看。
items.en_points: An exhibition pairs Christina A. West's clay sculptures of the male nude with David Lynch's photogravures, published by Tandem Press, exploring the figure and looking.

items.title: 97,000-square-foot West YMCA set to open in Fitchburg in 2028
items.zh_title: Fitchburg新YMCA预计2028年开业
items.zh_points: 占地9.7万平方英尺的新West YMCA已在McKee Road动工，预计2028年开放；住在Fitchburg一带的学生未来多一个健身去处。
items.en_points: Work is underway on a new, larger 97,000-square-foot West YMCA on McKee Road in Fitchburg, slated to open in 2028.

items.title: Madison earns spot on prestigious 'Best of the World' list
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊首次入选Best of the World榜单
items.zh_points: 麦迪逊凭城市与户外兼具的特色首次上榜，与印度斋浦尔、埃及卢克索、澳大利亚墨尔本同列。
items.en_points: For the first time, Madison made a prestigious 'Best of the World' list for its mix of urban and outdoor offerings, alongside Jaipur, Luxor and Melbourne.

items.title: Generative AI in music is death of creative connection
items.zh_title: Badger Herald评论批评AI生成音乐
items.zh_points: Badger Herald评论指出AI生成的歌曲已登上Spotify、iTunes等平台排行榜，作者认为这会削弱人与创作之间的联系。
items.en_points: A Badger Herald column argues that AI-generated songs, now reaching Spotify and iTunes charts, threaten the human connection behind creative work.

items.title: Delta Beer Lab closing after nearly 8 years in Madison area
items.zh_title: Delta Beer Lab营业近8年后将关闭
items.zh_points: 麦迪逊地区精酿酒厂Delta Beer Lab即将关门，最后一周安排知识问答、宾果和手作市集。
items.en_points: Madison-area brewery Delta Beer Lab is shutting down; its final week features trivia, bingo and a makers market.

items.title: Children's Theater of Madison opens season with 'Annie' debut
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊儿童剧院以《Annie》开启新演出季
items.zh_points: Children's Theater of Madison以《Annie》首演开启本季演出，摘要未提供场次信息。
items.en_points: The Children's Theater of Madison is starting its new season with a debut of 'Annie'; no show dates were given.

items.title: Ho-Chunk Gaming Beloit opens Friday
items.zh_title: 贝洛伊特新赌场Ho-Chunk Gaming周五开业
items.zh_points: Ho-Chunk Gaming Beloit于10月23日14:00对外开业，当天11:00剪彩，随后有小型powwow；这是Ho-Chunk在威州的第7家场馆。
items.en_points: Ho-Chunk Gaming Beloit, the seventh Ho-Chunk casino in Wisconsin, opens Friday, Oct. 23, at 2 p.m., after an 11 a.m. ribbon cutting and a mini powwow.

items.title: Madison City Council votes to fire interim police monitor in marathon meeting
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊市议会表决解雇临时警察监督员
items.zh_points: 麦迪逊市议会经过长达12小时的通宵会议，以14比6的表决结果解雇了临时独立警察监督员。
items.en_points: The Madison City Council voted 14-6 to fire Interim Independent Police Monitor Aeiramique Glass after a 12-hour marathon meeting.

items.title: Early voting now underway for Wisconsin midterm election
items.zh_title: 威斯康星州中期选举提前投票启动
items.zh_points: 威斯康星州中期选举提前投票现已开始，本次焦点为Tom Tiffany与David Crowley竞逐州长职位。
items.en_points: Early voting is now underway across Wisconsin for the midterm election, featuring the gubernatorial contest between Tom Tiffany and David Crowley.

items.title: Beautiful weather set to continue into the weekend
items.zh_title: 南威斯康星温和晴朗持续至周末
items.zh_points: 威斯康星州南部本周维持温和晴好天气，最高气温在70华氏度低段，晴朗平稳将持续至周末。
items.en_points: Mild and calm weather continues across southern Wisconsin with highs in the low 70s lasting into the weekend.

items.title: Madison receives over $218 million to reinstate passenger rail service
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊获逾2.18亿美元重通客运铁路
items.zh_points: 麦迪逊市获得逾2.18亿美元联邦资金以扩建Amtrak客运列车项目，恢复往返麦迪逊的客运客车服务。
items.en_points: Madison will receive over $218 million in federal funds to expand the Amtrak passenger rail service.

items.title: Mindful Meditation
items.zh_title: Nick健身中心提供免费正念冥想课
items.zh_points: Nicholas Recreation Center向UW学生及会员提供免费冥想课，需提前预约，适合放松与提升注意力。
items.en_points: Nicholas Recreation Center offers free guided meditation classes for UW students and Rec Well members with registration required.

items.title: Early voting at Memorial Union, including same-day voter registration Early voting is formally known as in-person absentee voting in Wisconsin
items.zh_title: Memorial Union开放提前投票与现场注册
items.zh_points: 威州选民即日起可在Memorial Union二楼主休息室参与提前投票并办理现场选民登记。
items.en_points: Eligible voters can register and cast ballots at the Memorial Union Main Lounge during early voting hours.

items.title: Going Beyond Subject Matter: How to Identify Skills Employers Want
items.zh_title: 研究生院举办职场求职技能线上讲座
items.zh_points: 线上免费讲座指导研究生梳理学术科研中积累的通用技能，提升向非学术界雇主投递简历与面试的表达能力。
items.en_points: A free webinar helps graduate students identify transferable skills and communicate their value to nonacademic employers in job documents and interviews.

items.title: Fulbright office hours
items.zh_title: Bascom大楼设富布莱特项目周三答疑
items.zh_points: Bascom Hall 256室每周三设开放答疑，向UW学生、教职及国际学者解答富布莱特申请与交流项目问题。
items.en_points: Bascom Hall Room 256 hosts weekly Wednesday drop-in hours to answer questions about Fulbright programs for UW students, faculty, and scholars.

items.title: Early voting at Union South, including same-day voter registration Early voting is formally known as in-person absentee voting in Wisconsin
items.zh_title: Union South开放提前投票与现场登记
items.zh_points: Union South提供威州选民现场登记与提前投票服务，地点位于治理与校友活动室。
items.en_points: Union South hosts in-person early voting and same-day voter registration in the Governance & Alumni Rooms.

items.title: Peer Support Drop-In Hours w/ Badger Supports
items.zh_title: SAC开放同伴心理健康支持咨询时间
items.zh_points: Student Activity Center 3203室提供免预约同伴心理支持，可咨询校园健康资源并领取指引卡片。
items.en_points: Badger Supports hosts drop-in peer support hours at the Student Mental Health Hub in SAC Room 3203.

items.title: How to watch Wednesday’s gubernatorial debate between David Crowley and Tom Tiffany
items.zh_title: 威州州长选举候选人周三举行辩论
items.zh_points: 威州州长候选人David Crowley与Tom Tiffany周三举行首场辩论，目前民调显示选情胶着。
items.en_points: Wisconsin gubernatorial candidates David Crowley and Tom Tiffany face off in a debate on Wednesday, with polls showing a tight race.

items.title: Opening of IKEA store in Madison is pushed back
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊宜家商场推迟开业时间
items.zh_points: 原定于今年底开业的麦迪逊宜家家居商场已确认推迟开业，具体新营业日期暂未公布。
items.en_points: The opening of the new IKEA store in Madison, originally scheduled for before the end of the year, has been pushed back.

items.title: Madison Students for Democratic Society protest against firing of Independent Police Monitor
items.zh_title: UW学生社团在图书馆商场游行抗议
items.zh_points: 麦迪逊民主社会学生会在Library Mall组织游行，抗议麦迪逊市议会解雇临时独立警察监督员。
items.en_points: Madison Students for Democratic Society rallied at Library Mall to protest the city's decision to fire the Interim Independent Police Monitor.

items.title: Baldwin, Crowley speak to students at Library Mall, kicking off early voting
items.zh_title: 鲍德温与克劳利在校内演讲宣传投票
items.zh_points: 参议员Tammy Baldwin与州长候选人David Crowley在Library Mall向UW学生发表演讲，宣传提前投票。
items.en_points: Sen. Tammy Baldwin and gubernatorial candidate David Crowley spoke to students at Library Mall to promote early voting for the midterm election.

items.title: The AI effect
items.zh_title: 文理学院人文探索中心研究AI与不确定性
items.zh_points: UW麦迪逊文理学院通过AI与不确定性人文探究中心，组织学者深入探讨人工智能带来的复杂社会课题。
items.en_points: Researchers in UW's College of Letters & Science explore tough AI questions through the Center for Humanistic Inquiry into AI and Uncertainty.

items.title: Energizing first-time voters
items.zh_title: 人类生态学院学生助首次选民了解选举
items.zh_points: UW人类生态学院学生参与设计，将复杂的选举投票流程转化为通俗直观的体验，助力首次投票选民。
items.en_points: UW-Madison School of Human Ecology students are helping make election processes more approachable for first-time voters.

items.title: Relax, Pal: Frat culture and desensitization
items.zh_title: 学生评论反思兄弟会文化与脱敏现象
items.zh_points: Badger Herald评论文章探讨UW近期兄弟会霸凌事件，反思社交媒体对欺凌与侵害现象的脱敏倾向。
items.en_points: A Badger Herald opinion column examines desensitization to sexual assault and fraternity hazing incidents at UW and nationwide.

items.title: Teaching with Intent: Building Awareness, Empathy, and Purpose in the Classroom Taught by Trisha Adamus, Ebling librarian
items.zh_title: Ebling图书馆举办教学工作坊
items.zh_points: Ebling图书馆员在线主持一小时工作坊，探讨课堂共情沟通与个人教学理念建立，适合助教与教学人员。
items.en_points: An Ebling librarian hosts a one-hour online workshop on classroom empathy and building a teaching philosophy, open to instructors and TAs.

items.title: Public Works: Best Practices for Navigating Media Opportunities
items.zh_title: 人文社科媒体传播讲座探讨投递采访
items.zh_points: 讲座在University Club探讨人文学者如何对接播客与新闻媒体，分享向记者投稿、采访准备与科研通俗化经验。
items.en_points: A panel at University Club covers media best practices for humanities scholars, including pitching stories and communicating research to the public.

items.title: ACLU of Wisconsin question license plate reader privacy

items.en_points: A Marquette Law School poll finds Wisconsin residents skeptical of automated license plate readers like Flock Safety's; the ACLU of Wisconsin questions their privacy.

items.title: Republican Sen. Patrick Testin weighs Wisconsin Senate battle

items.en_points: GOP state Sen. Patrick Testin discussed Republicans' effort to keep their state Senate majority in an election that could reshape control of state government.

items.title: Wisconsin Democrats seek first governing trifecta in 16 years
items.zh_title: 民主党争取16年来首次全面执政
items.zh_points: 州参议院民主党领袖 Dianne Hesselbein 表示，民主党16年来首次有机会同时拿下州长职位和议会两院。
items.en_points: State Senate Democratic Leader Dianne Hesselbein says Democrats have their first chance in 16 years to win the governorship and both legislative chambers.

items.title: Midwest Minutes: Four things to do around Wisconsin (Oct. 19-25)
items.zh_title: 本周威州四项活动推荐（10/19-25）

items.en_points: With Halloween two weeks away, a Channel 3000 video picks four spooky and not-so-spooky things to do around Wisconsin, Oct. 19-25.

items.title: Black youth voter research highlights community priorities ahead of Wisconsin governor’s race
items.zh_title: 研究：黑人青年关心社区但投票受阻
items.zh_points: Tufts 大学 CIRCLE 研究显示，18-34岁黑人青年积极投入社区事务，但投票仍面临障碍；报道聚焦威州州长选举前的议题。
items.en_points: Tufts CIRCLE research finds Black youth ages 18-34 are invested in their communities but still face barriers to voting, ahead of Wisconsin's governor's race.

items.title: Fitchburg firefighters quickly extinguish apartment fire

items.en_points: Fitchburg firefighters quickly put out a fire at two apartment units on High Ridge Trail early Saturday; no one was hurt and other units were protected.

items.en_points: Arboretum family nature walk and activities on migrations for kids elementary age and younger, Oct 18, 1:30-3:30 p.m.; free, no registration.

items.title: Botham Vineyards closing, returning to prairie and a homestead

items.en_points: Botham Vineyards is closing after nearly 38 years; the owners chose not to expand into events, a restaurant and a distillery and will return the land to prairie.

items.title: Middleton Scout organizes donation drive to help people experiencing homelessness

items.title: 33rd annual ‘Stand Down Madison’ helps veterans experiencing homelessness

items.en_points: A Freeze Warning is in effect across southern Wisconsin until 9 a.m. with sub-freezing lows, followed by a sunny, breezy weekend with highs in the 50s and 60s.

items.title: The Badger Herald Editorial Board: Midterm election guide, endorsements

items.en_points: The Badger Herald Editorial Board published its midterm election guide and endorsements; early voting runs through Nov. 1 ahead of the Nov. 3 election.

items.title: $218M federal funds secured for Hiawatha West rail expansion to Madison

items.en_points: Over $218 million in federal funds have been secured to expand Amtrak's Hiawatha rail service to Madison, connecting the city to Milwaukee and Chicago.

items.title: UW-Madison building pilot program to host students with summer lease gaps

items.en_points: UW-Madison and ASM are developing a pilot program to provide short-term, low-cost or free campus housing for students facing summer lease gaps between late July and mid-August.

items.en_points: Melly Mell's Soul Food celebrated its grand opening on Friday night at the Madison Public Market.

items.title: The Janus experience: UW student’s app helps peers achieve academic goals

items.title: Gibbor Artisan Bakery expands hours after warm community welcome

items.zh_points: 麦迪逊近东区新开业的Gibbor手作面包店深受社区欢迎，宣布延长营业时间，招牌包括提拉米苏可颂与巧克力可颂。
items.en_points: Gibbor Artisan Bakery on the Near East Side is expanding its hours following strong community demand for its croissants and pastries.

items.title: 19 great ideas for your Madison-area weekend
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊周末19项精彩活动盘点
items.zh_points: 《威斯康星州立日报》盘点本周末麦迪逊周边19项活动，涵盖现场音乐演出、户外探险及趣味赛事。
items.en_points: The Wisconsin State Journal compiles 19 weekend event ideas around Madison, featuring live music, outdoor adventures, and local activities.

items.title: Inside Epic System’s newest campus, where Narnia meets ‘Star Wars’
items.zh_title: Epic Systems启用第六科技园区
items.zh_points: 医疗科技巨头Epic Systems在维罗纳启用第六园区，建筑设计致敬《纳尼亚传奇》、《星球大战》和《指环王》的奇幻世界。
items.en_points: Verona-based healthcare tech giant Epic Systems unveiled its sixth campus, featuring buildings inspired by Narnia, Star Wars, and Lord of the Rings.

items.title: Judge: Wisconsin Veterans Museum can stay on Capitol Square for now
items.zh_title: 退伍军人博物馆暂留州议会广场
items.zh_points: 法官裁定退伍军人博物馆可暂留在Capitol Square原址，州政府与大楼私有业主正就该地块的改建计划进行诉讼竞争。
items.en_points: A judge ruled the Wisconsin Veterans Museum can remain on Capitol Square for now as the state and private landlords pursue competing redevelopment plans.

items.title: If you have any “Sense”, go see new Jane Austin adaptation
items.zh_title: 新版《理智与情感》公映评介
items.zh_points: UW电影馆举办简·奥斯汀经典改编新片《理智与情感》提前展映，该片于10月16日在美国正式院线上映。
items.en_points: UW Cinematheque held an advance screening of a new film adaptation of Jane Austen's 'Sense and Sensibility,' which opens nationwide on Oct. 16.

items.title: Edgewood University breaks ground on athletics and wellness campus
items.zh_title: 埃奇伍德大学开建综合体育校区
items.zh_points: 埃奇伍德大学在Fitchburg动工兴建40英亩的体育与健康校区，规划多项运动场地并修复12英亩湿地。
items.en_points: Edgewood University broke ground on a $30 million, 40-acre athletic and wellness campus in Fitchburg that includes multiple sports fields and 12 acres of restored wetlands.

items.title: 911 and the Pepperoni Pizza Myth
items.zh_title: 校警澄清订披萨报警纯属网络谣言
items.zh_points: 威斯康星大学警务处提醒：拨打911假装订意大利辣肠披萨并非官方急救暗号，接警员未受此训练，遇险请直接清晰求救。
items.en_points: UWPD warns that the viral 'pepperoni pizza 911 code' is a myth; dispatchers are not trained to interpret pizza orders as distress calls in emergencies.

items.title: Topics in Arithmetic Geometry Seminar Étale Fundamental Groups and Path Torsors
items.zh_title: 算术几何研讨会：平展基本群
items.zh_points: 数学系举办算术几何专题讨论，探讨平展基本群与路径扭子，下午1点在Van Vleck Hall B309举行。
items.en_points: The Topics in Arithmetic Geometry Seminar meets at 1 p.m. in B309 Van Vleck Hall to discuss étale fundamental groups and path torsors.

items.title: SIAM Seminar Driftless Star Team (UW Madison)
items.zh_title: SIAM研讨会：Driftless之星团队
items.zh_points: 工业与应用数学学会学生分会研讨会将于下午1点在Van Vleck Hall 911室举行。
items.en_points: The SIAM Seminar features the Driftless Star Team at 1 p.m. in 911 Van Vleck Hall.

items.title: Teaching at UW: Teaching with the Chazen Center for Teaching, Learning & Mentoring
items.zh_title: Chazen艺术博物馆教学工坊

items.en_points: The Center for Teaching, Learning and Mentoring hosts a session at the Chazen Museum of Art from noon to 1:15 p.m.

items.title: SBDC Built to Last: The Entrepreneur's Wellness Framework
items.zh_title: 小企业中心创业者心理健康讲座
items.zh_points: 威斯康星小企业发展中心推出为期五期的创业心理健康与抗压项目，帮助企业创办人缓解职业倦怠。
items.en_points: The SBDC is hosting Built to Last, a five-session wellness program designed to help entrepreneurs manage stress and build resilience.

items.title: Department of Biostatistics & Medical Informatics Seminar with Muxuan Lian of MD Anderson Cancer Center Gradient-Augmented AI Calibration for Covariate Adjustment in Randomized Trials
items.zh_title: 生物统计系AI校准协变量研讨会
items.zh_points: MD安德森癌症中心学者分享基于AI校准改善随机试验治疗效应估计的GRACIAS框架，在Morgridge Hall 7560室及线上进行。
items.en_points: The Biostatistics seminar features Dr. Liang presenting the GRACIAS AI framework for randomized trials, held in 7560 Morgridge Hall and online.

items.title: Special Seminar in Biochemistry: Justin Crocker Exploring biological design space: from perturbation to phenotype
items.zh_title: 生物化学系专题研讨会：生物设计
items.zh_points: 来自EMBL的Justin Crocker学者主讲生物设计空间研讨会，上午11点在DeLuca生物化学大楼1211室举行。
items.en_points: Justin Crocker from EMBL speaks on exploring biological design space at 11 a.m. in 1211 DeLuca Biochemical Sciences Building.

items.title: GIS in Precision Agriculture Demonstration
items.zh_title: GIS精准农业应用演示与就业分享
items.zh_points: 农学行业代表在CS大楼3310室演示GIS在精准农业中的实际应用，并分享相关领域的工作与实习机会，上午11点至中午。
items.en_points: A demonstration at 3310 Computer Sciences from 11 a.m. to noon showcases GIS in precision agriculture along with career opportunities.

items.title: Mt. Mendota Top Rope Belay Clinic
items.zh_title: Bakke中心攀岩顶绳保护培训
items.zh_points: Bakke娱乐中心三层攀岩墙举办顶绳保护基础培训，无需攀爬经验或自带装备，上午10点30分开始。
items.en_points: Bakke Recreation Center hosts a top-rope belay clinic on its 3rd floor climbing wall at 10:30 a.m., with no experience or gear required.

items.title: ‘Stadium of Screams’ comes to Beloit
items.zh_title: 贝洛伊特球场万圣节鬼屋开放
items.zh_points: Beloit的ABC Supply体育场在10月每逢周末举办万圣节沉浸式鬼屋体验，门票每人20美元，晚7点入场。
items.en_points: ABC Supply Stadium in Beloit hosts the 'Stadium of Screams' haunted house Friday through Sunday through October 31; tickets are $20.

items.title: Proposed Rule Change to Collect OPT/STEM Fees
items.zh_title: DHS 拟对首次 OPT 申请收 7 万美元
items.zh_points: DHS 10/8 发布 OPT 收费拟议规则：F-1 首次申请 OPT 拟收 7 万美元，不适用于 CPT 和 J-1 学术培训。仍为提案，计划用 OPT 的同学需密切关注。
items.en_points: DHS proposed on Oct. 8 a $70,000 fee for an F-1 student's first OPT application; it does not apply to CPT or J-1 Academic Training. Still only a proposal; watch for updates.
items.action: F-1 学生查看 ISS 10/14 邮件，关注规则进展

items.title: UW-Madison biology merger raises staff concerns over layoffs, botany’s future
items.zh_title: UW植物与整合生物系合并引担忧
items.zh_points: UW将植物学系与整合生物学系合并为生物系，教工担忧植物学被边缘化与裁员，但校方称本科专业均保持不变。
items.en_points: UW-Madison merged botany and integrative biology into a new Biology Department, sparking staff concerns over botany's future, though undergraduate programs remain unchanged.

items.title: Flu season is arriving months early. Here's where it's spreading
items.zh_title: CDC：今年流感季提前数月到来
items.zh_points: CDC 称今年流感在美国部分地区提早出现，8 月底至 9 月初就开始升温。流感季比往年早数月，可考虑尽早接种疫苗、注意防护。
items.en_points: The CDC says flu began picking up in parts of the U.S. in late August and early September, months earlier than usual. Consider getting a flu shot early.

items.title: Dane County supervisor seeks to cut $3 million for sheriff’s body cameras until policies are in place
items.zh_title: 戴恩县议员提议削减警局随身执法仪预算
items.zh_points: 戴恩县议员提出修正案，主张在明确隐私与调阅政策前暂缓300万美元警用执法仪拨款。
items.en_points: A Dane County supervisor proposed pausing $3 million for sheriff's body cameras until clear public access and privacy policies are adopted.

items.title: Student Judiciary dismisses second brief claiming ASM Chair election process violations
items.zh_title: ASM学生司法委员会驳回主席选举程序诉请
items.zh_points: 学生司法委员会驳回了针对春季学生会主席选举违规提出的第二份诉请书，维持原决议。
items.en_points: The ASM Student Judiciary dismissed a second brief alleging procedural violations during the spring chair election, keeping the results in place.

items.title: The Compass: AI, Ethics, and Human Judgment - a Livestreamed Seminar
items.zh_title: 线上座谈：AI、伦理与人的判断
items.zh_points: UW 举办线上直播公开座谈，讨论 AI 对决策、责任、教育和司法的影响，灵感来自互动戏剧《The Compass》，欢迎学生参与。
items.en_points: UW–Madison livestreams a public panel on how AI shapes decisions, responsibility, education and justice, inspired by the interactive play The Compass; students are invited.

items.title: Benefits 2027: What You Need to Know Information for benefits-eligible UW–Madison employees
items.zh_title: UW 员工 2027 福利开放注册 10/30 截止
items.zh_points: 面向有福利资格的 UW 员工：开放注册期 10/30 16:30 结束。线上说明会讲解 2027 福利变化和注册方法，录像见 benefits.wisc.edu/2027。
items.en_points: For benefits-eligible UW–Madison employees: open enrollment ends 4:30 p.m. Oct. 30. An online session covers 2027 changes and how to enroll; recording at benefits.wisc.edu/2027.
items.action: 如有员工福利资格，10/30 16:30 前完成福利选择

items.title: Being a TA in the U.S. Classroom: Practicing Effective Communication
items.zh_title: 工作坊：在美国课堂当 TA 如何有效沟通
items.zh_points: 工作坊练习在美国课堂当 TA 时如何有效沟通，适合初次在美国课堂任教的助教。Levy Hall 3204，12:00-13:30。
items.en_points: Workshop on practicing effective communication as a TA in U.S. classrooms, useful for TAs new to American teaching. 3204 Levy Hall, noon-1:30 p.m.

items.title: Rain Likely Today, Tonight & Friday
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊周四周五有雨，周五夜或有霜冻
items.zh_points: 今天下午到夜间有阵雨，部分地区雨量约半英寸或更多，可能打雷；周五仍有零星阵雨。最高气温华氏 50 多度，周五夜可能霜冻，下周回暖。出门记得带伞。
items.en_points: Showers this afternoon and tonight, half an inch or more in spots, possible thunder; lingering showers Friday. Highs upper 50s; frost likely Friday night; warmer next week.

items.title: Wisconsin Science Festival returns with free STEAM events
items.zh_title: 威斯康星科学节回归，免费活动至 10/25
items.zh_points: 第 16 届威斯康星科学节周四开幕，全州数百场活动持续到 10/25；周四 Madison 市中心有户外 STEAM 体验，也可去儿童博物馆。
items.en_points: The 16th Wisconsin Science Festival opens Thursday with hundreds of events statewide through Oct. 25, starting with outdoor STEAM activities in downtown Madison.

items.title: ASM calls special order for UHS sexual violence survey announcement
items.zh_title: UHS 春季将开展性暴力与心理健康调查
items.zh_points: UHS 在学生会 ASM 会议上宣布，春季将开展两项调查，涉及性暴力、校园氛围和心理健康；需要高回复率结果才可靠，届时可留意参与。
items.en_points: At an ASM meeting, UHS announced two spring surveys on sexual violence, campus climate and mental health; results need a high response rate to be reliable.

items.title: MPD seeks new drone program to promote de-escalation
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊警方申请拨款试点无人机出警
items.zh_points: MPD 申请 20 万美元联邦拨款，试点“无人机先行响应”项目，称有助缓和冲突；该类拨款用于搜救、追捕、对峙及健康探访等。目前仍在申请阶段。
items.en_points: Madison police seek a $200,000 federal grant to pilot a 'Drone as First Responders' program meant to aid de-escalation; uses include search and rescue and wellness checks.

items.title: Save the dates: Help shape the future of Wisconsin’s universities
items.zh_title: UW 系统校长决选人 10/26、10/27 公开论坛
items.zh_points: UW 系统校长决选人将出席 10/26 和 10/27 两场公开论坛，两场人选相同，学生可借机直接听候选人发言。
items.en_points: Finalists for Universities of Wisconsin president appear at public forums Oct. 26 and Oct. 27; the same finalists attend both, a chance to hear them directly.

items.title: Statistics Seminar David Dahl: Bayesian Clustering with Elicited Beliefs about Cluster Sizes
items.zh_title: 统计讲座：用簇大小先验做贝叶斯聚类
items.zh_points: David Dahl 讲 Lorenz 划分分布：聚类时可同时设定簇数和簇大小，减少过度拆分。适合统计方向同学，Morgridge 7560，13:00-14:00。
items.en_points: David Dahl presents the Lorenz partition distribution, a Bayesian clustering prior that sets both cluster count and sizes to curb over-splitting. 7560 Morgridge Hall, 1-2 p.m.

items.title: Mellon/ACLS Dissertation Innovation Fellowship Office Hours
items.zh_title: Mellon/ACLS 博士论文奖学金线上答疑
items.zh_points: ACLS 通过 Zoom 开设答疑时段，解答博士论文创新奖学金申请问题。先到先得，建议提前注册，满员可邮件 fellowships@acls.org 候补。
items.en_points: ACLS holds Zoom office hours on the Dissertation Innovation Fellowship. First come, first served; register ahead or email fellowships@acls.org for the waitlist.

items.title: Knitting 101
items.zh_title: Memorial Union 开三周编织入门课
items.zh_points: Memorial Union Studio G 开 3 周编织入门课，教下针、上针等基础技能，学完可独立做作品。13:00-15:30，费用 100 美元。
items.en_points: A 3-week beginner knitting course in Memorial Union's Studio G covering knitting, purling and other basics. 1-3:30 p.m.; costs $100.

items.title: Ecological Restoration Work Party Arboretum Grady Tract Seed Collecting

items.zh_points: 志愿者为植物园草原和稀树草原修复采集本地野花种子，提供工具和培训。需经 VolunteerMatters 提前报名（10/12 已截止），名额有限。
items.en_points: Volunteers gather native wildflower seed for Arboretum prairie and savanna restorations; tools and training provided. Registration via VolunteerMatters closed Oct. 12.

items.zh_title: 贫困研究所讲座：日落镇与种族化公共空间
items.zh_points: 明尼苏达大学社会学副教授 Michael Esposito 主讲，属 IRP 2026 秋季讲座系列。Sewell 8417，12:15-13:30。
items.en_points: University of Minnesota associate professor Michael Esposito speaks on sundown towns in the IRP Fall 2026 Seminar Series. 8417 Sewell Social Sciences, 12:15-1:30 p.m.

items.zh_title: 病理学大查房：胰岛旁分泌信号新通路
items.zh_points: UW 的 Dawn Davis 医生线上讲胰岛中胰岛素和胰高血糖素之外的新型旁分泌信号通路，12:00-13:00，经 Zoom 参加。
items.en_points: UW's Dawn Davis, MD, presents novel islet paracrine signaling pathways beyond insulin and glucagon. Online via Zoom, noon-1 p.m.

items.title: Learn to Play Sagrada Taught by Joe King, Ebling librarian
items.zh_title: Ebling 图书馆教你玩桌游 Sagrada
items.zh_points: Ebling 图书馆员 Joe King 教大家玩桌游 Sagrada：用骰子拼出彩色玻璃窗，一小时内就能学会。线下活动，需报名。

items.title: Exploring AI in Teaching: Student Use Survey Center for Teaching, Learning & Mentoring
items.zh_title: AI 与教学系列：学生 AI 使用调查
items.zh_points: 教学、学习与指导中心 (CTLM) 的 AI 教学系列线上活动，主题为学生使用 AI 的调查，12:00-13:30。当 TA 的同学可参考。
items.en_points: Online session in the Center for Teaching, Learning & Mentoring's Exploring AI in Teaching series, on a survey of student AI use. Noon-1:30 p.m.

items.title: CSA Fall 2026 Lecture Series Taymour Soomro, "Reading: 'The Calcutta Affair,' a short story"

items.en_points: Taymour Soomro reads the short story 'The Calcutta Affair,' about a young Englishman's affair in early-1970s Calcutta. 206 Ingraham Hall or online, noon-1 p.m.

items.title: CommUniversity Sessions: Updates on Early Childhood Programming and Impacts on Our Human Ecology
items.zh_title: 社区讲座：早期儿童照护现状与影响
items.zh_points: CommNS 邀请 WECA 的 Paula Drew 等人，讨论威斯康星及全美早期儿童照护的现状，以及对家庭和行业职业的影响。
items.en_points: CommNS hosts Paula Drew of the Wisconsin Early Childhood Association on early childhood care issues in Wisconsin and the U.S. and what they mean for families and careers.

items.title: Bridge & Build Community October Luncheon Open to all graduate students.

items.zh_points: 面向全体研究生的交流午餐会，研究生院 DELTA 项目将介绍一个帮研究生和博后提升教学与指导能力的同伴学习社群。午餐先到先得。

items.zh_title: 讲座：数据系统中 LLM 算子的优化

items.en_points: Shreya Shankar, CMU assistant professor (2027), on optimizing LLM-powered operators in data systems beyond UDFs. 11 a.m.-12:15 p.m., also on Zoom.

items.title: Driver seriously injured after multi-car crash Wednesday near Pflaum Road
items.zh_title: Pflaum Rd 路口多车相撞，一名司机重伤

items.title: All aboard! Here’s the Holiday Train schedule for Southern Wisconsin
items.zh_title: 假日列车 12 月停靠南威斯康星时间表

items.title: Neighbors describe hearing plane crash that killed six in Sauk County

items.title: Cameron Winter’s live album offers new renditions of familiar songs
items.zh_title: 乐评：Cameron Winter 发布现场专辑

items.en_points: Geese frontman Cameron Winter released 'Live at Carnegie Hall' on Friday, with new renditions of the 12 songs he played at the New York venue.

items.title: Spirit Halloween finds its next location: Mnookin’s empty office

items.zh_points: Badger Herald 恶搞栏目 Banter 的玩笑文章，称 Spirit Halloween 进驻前校长 Mnookin 的空办公室，并非真实新闻。
items.en_points: A satirical Badger Herald Banter piece joking that Spirit Halloween moved into former Chancellor Mnookin's vacant office on Bascom Hill; not real news.

items.title: Proposed Rule Change to Collect OPT/STEM Fees
items.zh_title: 国土安全部拟对 OPT 收费：首次 7 万美元
items.zh_points: DHS 10/8 发布拟议规则：F-1 首次 OPT 收费 7 万美元，之后每次（含 STEM 延期）3 万美元；CPT、J-1 不适用。仅为草案、未生效，意见征集到 11/9。
items.en_points: DHS proposed a $70,000 fee for an F-1 student's first OPT and $30,000 for each later one, STEM extensions included; CPT and J-1 are exempt. Not final; comments close Nov 9.

items.title: Using Financial Aid towards Study Abroad Drop-in Advising Sessions
items.zh_title: 今日答疑：助学金能否用于出国学习

items.en_points: Financial Aid office staff hold drop-in advising today, 2-4 p.m., at the Study Abroad Resource Center (Red Gym, 3rd floor) on using aid for study abroad.

items.title: Mid-Semester Refresh: Refocusing and Recharging Your Writing Practices
items.zh_title: 期中写作工作坊：应对写作瓶颈与时间管理
items.zh_points: 写作中心与McBurney残障资源中心今天合办线上工作坊，讲突破写作瓶颈、管理时间和梳理思路，适合被期中作业压着的同学。
items.en_points: Online Writing Center and McBurney workshop today on getting past writer's block, managing time and organizing ideas during midterm season.

items.en_points: Online session today, 11 a.m.-noon, on study abroad costs, financial aid, scholarships and saving strategies, with Student Financial Aid. Zoom registration required.

items.en_points: Badger Supports peer drop-in hours today, 10:30 a.m.-1 p.m., at the Student Mental Health Hub (SAC Room 3203): ask about campus resources or upcoming events.

items.title: Cooler Temperatures Today Before Rain Moves in Tomorrow
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊降温，周四有雨，周末或有霜冻
items.zh_points: 今天最高约16-18°C；周四白天到夜间可能下雨，周五阵风大，周五六最高降至10-15°C，周末或有霜冻，记得带伞添衣。
items.en_points: Highs in the low to mid-60s today; rain likely Thursday into Thursday night, gusty winds Friday, highs in the 50s Friday-Saturday and possible frost into the weekend.

items.title: Vision Zero: Madison’s vision for safer streets
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊交通安全计划 Vision Zero 称进展显著
items.zh_points: 麦迪逊2020年启动Vision Zero，目标是消除道路重伤和致死事故；市政府10/12通报称进展显著，交通工程部门持续改造街道。与步行、骑车通勤的同学相关。
items.en_points: Madison's Vision Zero, launched in 2020 to end serious and fatal crashes, reported significant progress in an Oct. 12 release; city engineers keep redesigning streets.

items.title: Kratom exposure reports to Poisons Centers climb nationwide
items.zh_title: 全美 Kratom 中毒报告上升，效果类似阿片
items.zh_points: 威斯康星中毒中心毒理学家称，Kratom是有精神活性的草本补充剂，作用类似阿片类，可致危及生命的后果；别把它当普通保健品。
items.en_points: Poison center reports on kratom, an herbal supplement with opioid-like effects, are rising nationwide; a Wisconsin toxicologist warns of life-threatening outcomes.

items.title: A work party for a Nobel Prize
items.zh_title: 物理学教授 Halzen 获诺奖后返校庆祝
items.zh_points: UW物理学教授Francis Halzen获2026年诺贝尔物理学奖，返校后与同事举行庆祝聚会，UW News发布组图。
items.en_points: UW–Madison physics professor Francis Halzen, winner of the 2026 Nobel Prize in physics, celebrated with colleagues after returning to campus; UW News posted a photo gallery.

items.title: Sci-prov: The Workshops - Listening & Empathy Free workshop - better science communication through improv!

items.en_points: Free improv workshop on listening for better science communication, today 2-4 p.m., 1145 Discovery Building. For STEM grad students, postdocs and staff; RSVP required.

items.en_points: Workshop series on making analyses reproducible beyond your own laptop: missing package versions, machine-specific paths, drifting environments. Room 3139 Computer Sciences.

items.zh_points: 微软研究院Rob Schapire今天12:30在Discovery Building做SILO讲座，主题是无穷远处的凸分析(astral space)。
items.en_points: Rob Schapire of Microsoft Research gives a SILO seminar on convex analysis at infinity (astral space), 12:30 p.m. today, DeLuca Forum, Discovery Building.

items.title: Distinguished Entrepreneurs Lunch Program - Sponsored by Neider & Boucher, S.C. Therese Merkel, Owner of Tricky Foods

items.en_points: Tricky Foods owner Therese Merkel, a former Epic project manager, talks about leaving corporate work to build a Madison food brand. Midday today, 4151 Grainger Hall.

items.title: Tiny Workers, Huge Impact: Pollinators and Pollination in Wisconsin Agricultural Landscapes CHE Environmental Colloquium

items.en_points: Entomology research scientist Hannah Gaines Day speaks on pollinators in Wisconsin farm landscapes, noon-1 p.m. today, 1343 Computer Sciences. Hosted by CHE.

items.zh_title: 喀麦隆研究会议主旨演讲：母职与政治历史
items.zh_points: 一日学术会议的主旨演讲，Pamela Feldman-Savelsberg探讨喀麦隆的母职与政治历史；今天中午在Ingraham Hall 206，免费。
items.en_points: Keynote by Pamela Feldman-Savelsberg on motherhood, politics and history in Cameroon, part of a one-day conference. Noon today, 206 Ingraham Hall; free.

items.title: Recent Grad Panel on Job Searching
items.zh_title: 护理学院校友分享求职与实习经验

items.en_points: Recent nursing grads share how they gained experience in school and found jobs and externships. 11 a.m.-noon today, Signe Skott Cooper Hall auditorium.

items.title: Kanopy Dance celebrates 50 years with 'Without Borders' performance
items.zh_title: Kanopy 舞团庆祝成立 50 周年

items.en_points: Madison's Kanopy Dance is celebrating its 50th anniversary with a performance called Without Borders.

items.title: Inflation worsened last month to 3.7% in sign that prices remain elevated as midterm elections near
items.zh_title: 美国9月通胀升至3.7%，汽油机票变贵
items.zh_points: 美国9月CPI涨幅升至3.7%，汽油、服装和机票变贵；日常开销和机票预算可能要多留余量。
items.en_points: U.S. consumer prices rose 3.7% in September as gas, clothes and airfares got pricier; leave more room in your budget for daily costs and flights.

items.title: Wisconsin Dells’ Wild WaterDome Waterpark Reopens
items.zh_title: 威斯康星戴尔斯水上乐园翻新后重开
items.zh_points: Wilderness Resort的Wild WaterDome在8月闭园翻新后于10/9重开，新增火山主题多人皮筏滑道和透明屋顶。
items.en_points: The Wilderness Resort's Wild WaterDome in Wisconsin Dells reopened Oct. 9 after renovations, with a new volcano-themed raft slide and a see-through roof.

items.en_points: At an Oct. 13 Union South panel, UW faculty and Indigenous representatives discussed working with Tribal nations to handle biological specimens respectfully.

items.title: 5 adults, 1 child confirmed dead in Sauk County plane crash
items.zh_title: 索克县小飞机坠毁，6人全部遇难
items.zh_points: 索克县Dellona镇周二晚约9:31发生坠机，六座小飞机上5名成人和1名儿童全部遇难，遇难者姓名尚未公布。
items.en_points: A six-passenger plane crashed around 9:31 p.m. Tuesday in the Town of Dellona, Sauk County, killing all five adults and one child aboard; names not yet released.

items.title: Southern Wisconsin residents bring 765-kV transmission line fight to State Capitol

items.en_points: Hundreds of residents from 10 southern Wisconsin counties lobbied lawmakers at the State Capitol Tuesday against two proposed 765-kV transmission lines, BECI and MariBell.

items.title: McFarland Village Board votes against sewerage rate increases
items.zh_title: 麦克法兰反对麦迪逊污水区涨价约9.9%
items.zh_points: 麦迪逊都市污水区(MMSD)拟涨费，原提案近12%，现约9.9%；McFarland村委会周二以7比0反对，并担心今后涨幅没有上限。
items.en_points: McFarland's board voted 7-0 against Madison Metropolitan Sewerage District rate hikes, now proposed at about 9.9% (down from nearly 12%), citing no cap on future rates.

items.title: Wisconsin joins 13 other states in a federal lawsuit against the Trump administration’s Department of Labor
items.zh_title: 威州与另外13州起诉联邦劳工部撤销拨款
items.zh_points: 联邦劳工部终止7.8亿美元已承诺拨款，其中3100万美元原拨给威州；威州与另外13个州一同起诉。
items.en_points: Wisconsin and 13 other states sued the U.S. Labor Department over its termination of $780 million in promised grants, including $31 million for Wisconsin.

items.title: UW approved $12.5 million to improve salary market competitiveness
items.zh_title: UW 拨1250万美元提升员工薪资竞争力
items.zh_points: 2026-27财年拨750万美元做永久底薪调整、500万美元发一次性绩效奖金，用于留人和提高低薪员工收入；各学院自定资格。
items.en_points: UW will put $12.5 million into employee pay for 2026-27: $7.5M in permanent base-pay raises, $5M in one-time bonuses; each school or college sets eligibility.

items.title: Madison police seek suspect in stabbing on Willy Street
