items.en_points: UW and UHS are adding a role in the Fraternity and Sorority Life office to prevent sexual violence, heavy drinking and bullying. All students were emailed Thursday.

items.title: David Crowley announces student renter protections in new renters plan
items.zh_title: 州长候选人提出学生租客权利法案
items.zh_points: 民主党候选人Crowley提议保护学生租客，防止被迫提前签约、克扣押金和不公平的室友连带责任。目前只是竞选承诺。
items.en_points: Democratic candidate Crowley proposes protecting student renters from forced early leasing, withheld deposits and unfair roommate liability. Just a campaign pledge.

items.title: Flu Season Is Here: 3 Steps to Take Now
items.zh_title: 流感季来了：现在该做的三件事
items.zh_points: 建议秋季早点接种年度流感疫苗。校内可到UHS预约接种。
items.en_points: Get your annual flu shot early in the fall. On campus, you can book one at UHS.

items.title: Save the date: Oct. 23 Nobel Prize celebration
items.zh_title: 10月23日诺贝尔奖庆祝讲座
items.zh_points: 10月23日下午2:30到4点在Morgridge Hall 7560有Halzen教授诺奖讲座，之后有茶会，欢迎所有人。
items.en_points: Prof. Halzen gives a Nobel lecture Oct. 23, 2:30 to 4 pm in Morgridge Hall 7560, followed by a tea reception. All are welcome.

items.title: A message about sexual violence prevention and support from Vice Chancellor for Student Affairs Lori Reesor
items.zh_title: 学生事务副校长谈性暴力预防与支持
items.zh_points: 校方重申认真对待每份性不当行为报告，并向全体学生群发邮件说明预防和支持资源。建议了解求助渠道。
items.en_points: UW says it takes every sexual misconduct report seriously and emailed all students about prevention and support resources. Know where to get help.

items.title: What new Dane County budget proposal could mean for students, community members
items.zh_title: Dane县2027预算提案：8.468亿美元
items.zh_points: 县长Agard提出2027年预算，继续投入平价住房并削减赤字。预算与租房和本地服务有关。
items.en_points: County Executive Agard proposed a 2027 budget that keeps funding affordable housing and cuts the deficit. It touches renting and local services.

items.title: Reducing Drug-Related Harm on Campus
items.zh_title: UHS：减少校园药物伤害
items.zh_points: UHS介绍药物预防项目，提醒合成阿片类药物的过量风险，并提供减害资源和教育。
items.en_points: UHS outlines its drug prevention programs, warns of overdose risk from synthetic opioids, and offers harm reduction resources and education.

items.title: University of Wisconsin–Madison Professor Francis Halzen named 2026 Nobel laureate in physics
items.zh_title: Halzen教授获2026诺贝尔物理学奖
items.zh_points: Halzen是全球最大望远镜NSF IceCube的首席研究员，10月6日获奖。
items.en_points: Halzen, principal investigator of NSF IceCube, the world's largest telescope, was named a laureate on Oct. 6.

items.title: Impact of “pocket rescissions” on IFLE programs
items.zh_title: “口袋撤销”削减国际外语教育经费
items.zh_points: 白宫9月25日撤销含7000万美元IFLE拨款，可能影响国家资源中心和FLAS奖学金。语言区域研究方向的同学需关注。
items.en_points: A Sept. 25 White House rescission included $70M in IFLE funding, which may hit National Resource Centers and FLAS fellowships. Language and area studies students, take note.

items.title: Connecting Badgers: Introduction to Mental Health Services Transcript
items.zh_title: UHS播客：心理健康服务入门
items.zh_points: 介绍新老学生如何联系UHS心理健康服务，适合想家、失眠、焦虑的同学。
items.en_points: Explains how new and returning students can reach UHS mental health services; useful for homesickness, insomnia or anxiety.

items.title: Bike and E-Scooter Theft — Awareness and Prevention
items.zh_title: UWPD提醒：电动车和滑板车失窃
items.zh_points: 8月27日至9月2日有三起电动车失窃，地点在Witte、Union South、Chadbourne外。开学季偷窃增多，请锁好车。有线索可打608-264-2677。
items.en_points: Three e-bike thefts Aug. 27 to Sept. 2 outside Witte, Union South and Chadbourne. Thefts rise as school starts, so lock up; tips to 608-264-2677.

items.title: Teaching Academy Fall Retreat Using AI Critically & Creatively
items.zh_title: 教学学院秋季研讨：批判性与创造性使用AI
items.zh_points: 面向教师、TA及教学支持人员，嘉宾分享用AI帮助学生表达想法、锻炼批判性思维的案例，并探讨AI素养。地点DeLuca Forum，当TA的同学可参加。
items.en_points: Retreat for instructors, TAs and teaching staff on using AI to help students express ideas and think critically, and on building AI literacy. At DeLuca Forum.

items.title: SBDC AI-Enhanced Entrepreneurship: A 102-Level Guide to AI Applications in Business
items.zh_title: SBDC线上讲座：AI在商业中的进阶应用
items.zh_points: 面向已用过AI工具的小企业主和职场人士，讲AI定制与人机结合的实际做法，线上9:00–10:30。有创业想法的同学可参考。
items.en_points: Online session, 9–10:30 a.m., for small business owners and professionals already using AI, on customizing tools and pairing AI with human expertise.

items.title: Ottoman and Turkish Studies Association (OTSA) Conference October 9-11, 2026 Professor Kemal H. Karpat and his Legacy: Professor Hakan Kirimli (Bilkent University)
items.zh_title: 奥斯曼与土耳其研究协会年会10/9–11举行
items.zh_points: 学术会议聚焦奥斯曼帝国及现当代土耳其研究，地点Pyle Center 225室，免费向公众开放。历史、中东研究方向的同学可旁听。
items.en_points: Free, public conference on Ottoman and modern Turkish studies, Oct. 9–11 at 225 Pyle Center, 9 a.m.–5:30 p.m.; relevant for history and Middle East studies students.

items.title: Lead Climbing Clinics
items.zh_title: Bakke攀岩墙开设先锋攀登课程
items.zh_points: 在Bakke中心三楼Mt. Mendota攀岩墙教室内先锋攀登与先锋保护，9:00–12:00，学生$10。需已有该馆顶绳保护认证并能稳定攀爬5.9难度。
items.en_points: A clinic at Bakke's Mt. Mendota wall teaches indoor lead climbing and lead belaying, 9 a.m.–noon, $10 for students. Requires Top Rope Belay certification and a solid 5.9.

items.title: COLOR POWER Exhibition at Mandelbaum & Albert Family Vision Gallery
items.zh_title: WIMR视觉画廊展出色彩主题艺术展
items.zh_points: 8位艺术家以色彩吸引注意、唤起情绪、传达意义，展于WIMR 9楼视觉画廊，8:30–17:00开放。
items.en_points: Eight artists use color to draw attention, evoke emotion and convey meaning in COLOR POWER, at WIMR's 9th-floor Vision Gallery, 8:30 a.m.–5 p.m.

items.title: Spotting AI-generated scams and fraud
items.zh_title: 如何识别AI生成的诈骗与造假内容
items.zh_points: News 3视频介绍判断内容是否为AI伪造的几种迹象，遇到可疑信息或视频时可对照参考。
items.en_points: A News 3 video covers signs that something is an AI-generated fake, useful when sizing up suspicious messages or videos.

items.title: 15-year-old shot, 2 arrested in East Side robbery: Madison police
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊东区抢劫案致15岁少年中枪，2人被捕
items.zh_points: 警方周二在医院接触一名中枪少年，他称在East High School附近遭枪击抢劫，2人已被捕。东区出行注意安全。
items.en_points: Madison police say a 15-year-old was shot in a robbery near East High School on Tuesday; two people were arrested.

items.title: Fact check: Did David Crowley double sales taxes in Milwaukee County?
items.zh_title: 事实核查：Crowley是否让密尔沃基县销售税翻倍
items.zh_points: 核查Tiffany广告中的说法：Crowley是否让密尔沃基县销售税翻倍。广告主打生活成本，这是威州选民最关注的议题之一。
items.en_points: A fact check of whether David Crowley doubled Milwaukee County sales taxes, as raised in a Tom Tiffany ad on affordability, a top worry for Wisconsin voters.

items.title: Tony Evers appoints UW-River Falls student to Board of Regents
items.zh_title: Evers任命UW-River Falls学生入董事会
items.zh_points: UW系统董事会(Board of Regents)18名成员中有2名学生，任期两年；本次新任命者是UW-River Falls的学生。
items.en_points: Gov. Tony Evers named a UW-River Falls student to the UW Board of Regents; two of its 18 members are students, serving two-year terms.

items.title: New name, same aim for Madison’s Traffic Engineering Division
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊交通工程处更名为出行与基础设施处
items.zh_points: 市政府称新名称更能体现该部门为各种出行方式的人服务，职能不变。查询交通事务时注意新名称。
items.en_points: Madison renamed its Traffic Engineering Division the Mobility and Infrastructure Division to reflect that it serves people using every mode of transportation.

items.title: Obama endorses Crowley in Wisconsin governor’s race
items.zh_title: 奥巴马为威州州长候选人Crowley背书
items.zh_points: 民主党人、密尔沃基县行政长官Crowley将在11/3大选中对阵特朗普支持的共和党联邦众议员Tiffany。有投票资格的同学可关注。
items.en_points: Obama endorsed Democrat David Crowley, the Milwaukee County executive, who faces Trump-backed Republican U.S. Rep. Tom Tiffany in the Nov. 3 governor's race.

items.title: ‘Great Pumpkin Giveaway’ returns to Fitchburg
items.zh_title: Fitchburg“南瓜大派送”周六回归
items.zh_points: 周六9:00–12:00在Fitchburg的Oak Bank（McKee Rd旁），可坐马车、挑南瓜，活动支持GiGi's Playhouse Madison。
items.en_points: Oak Bank in Fitchburg (off McKee Road) hosts its Great Pumpkin Giveaway Saturday 9 a.m.–noon with wagon rides and pumpkins, benefiting GiGi's Playhouse Madison.

items.title: Intro to Wheel Pottery
items.zh_title: 陶艺拉坯入门课
items.zh_points: 课程教拉坯、上釉，学费含12.5磅黏土和工具，课后两周可免费用工作室。想体验手作的同学可关注。
items.en_points: Learn wheel throwing and glazing; the fee covers 12.5 lb of clay and tools, plus two weeks of free studio use after class. Worth a look if you like crafts.

items.title: Frid-ai Reading Group: A Typology of Typos: Detecting Hallucinated Legal Citations Is Harder Than You Think A presentation by Prof. Ben Sobel, an Assistant Professor of Law at UW Law School
items.zh_title: AI读书会：AI幻觉法律引用难检测
items.zh_points: 法学院教授Sobel讲AI编造法律引文为何难识别，今天中午在University Club 313举行。
items.en_points: Law professor Sobel explains why AI-fabricated legal citations are hard to spot. Today at noon in University Club 313.

items.title: Department of Biostatistics & Medical Informatics Seminar Yin Li, Biostatistics & Medical Informatics, UW-Madison
items.zh_title: 生物统计系讲座：医疗视频AI模型
items.zh_points: Yin Li介绍用深度学习识别医疗器械和护理活动，在Morgridge Hall 7560举行。对医学AI感兴趣者可去。
items.en_points: Yin Li presents deep learning for recognizing medical devices and nursing activities, in Morgridge Hall 7560. Worth attending if you're into medical AI.

items.title: Center for Southeast Asian Studies Friday Forum: Juan Fernandez The Anthropologist as Anti-Hero: Masculinity's Misperformance and the Death of William Jones, 1909
items.zh_title: 东南亚研究中心周五论坛讲座
items.zh_points: 历史系助理教授Juan Fernandez讲1909年人类学家William Jones之死，中午举行，免费。
items.en_points: History assistant professor Juan Fernandez speaks on the 1909 death of anthropologist William Jones. At noon, free.

items.title: Sonic Authoritarianism: Influencers and their Nationalist Listeners Ivan L. Preston Research Colloquium with Aswin Punathambekar
items.zh_title: 传播学讲座：印度网红与民族主义
items.zh_points: 宾大教授Punathambekar讲印度右翼文化生产与平台化的政治虔诚，在Nafziger举行。
items.en_points: Penn professor Punathambekar discusses Indian right-wing cultural production and platformized political devotion, in Nafziger.

items.title: Men's and Women's Cross Country: Nuttycombe Wisconsin Invitational
items.zh_title: 越野跑Nuttycombe邀请赛
items.zh_points: 男女越野队在Verona的Zimmer XC场地举办邀请赛，10:30开始，想看比赛可前往。
items.en_points: The men's and women's cross country teams host an invitational at Zimmer XC in Verona, starting 10:30. Go watch if interested.

items.title: National Coming Out Day
items.zh_title: 全国出柜日活动
items.zh_points: 今天10点到4点在Library Mall和GSCC有咖啡、甜甜圈和手工活动，供应有限。
items.en_points: Today 10 am to 4 pm at Library Mall and the GSCC: coffee, donuts and crafts, while supplies last.

items.title: In Tandem: David Lynch & Christina A. West
items.zh_title: Lynch与West联展
items.zh_points: 展览把David Lynch的凹版摄影与Christina West的人体陶塑并置，探讨身体与凝视。
items.en_points: The exhibition pairs David Lynch's photogravures with Christina West's figurative ceramics to explore the body and the gaze.

items.title: Virtual Office Hours with CIO Didier Contis
items.zh_title: 信息技术副教务长线上答疑
items.zh_points: 每周五9:15到10点，CIO Contis在Zoom开放讨论，可就校园IT问题提问。
items.en_points: Every Friday 9:15 to 10 am, CIO Contis holds an open Zoom discussion where you can ask about campus IT.

items.title: 'Yes' for Reedsburg; 'no' on amendments
items.zh_title: 读者来信：11月3日三项州宪法修正案
items.zh_points: 读者提到11月3日选票上有三项威州宪法修正案，选民联盟建议全投反对。有投票资格的同学可提前了解。
items.en_points: A reader notes three Wisconsin constitutional amendments on the Nov. 3 ballot; a voter league urges a no vote on all. Eligible students can read up early.

items.title: Isaias gets stronger, heads to coastline
items.zh_title: 飓风Isaias增强逼近墨西哥湾沿岸
items.zh_points: 飓风周四增强，佛罗里达部分地区强制撤离。若近期要去墨西哥湾沿岸旅行，请留意。
items.en_points: The hurricane strengthened Thursday, with mandatory evacuations in parts of Florida. Take note if you plan to travel to the Gulf Coast soon.

items.title: A few showers as things warm up this afternoon
items.zh_title: 下午阵雨，周末转暖如夏
items.zh_points: 今天下午有阵雨，随后迎来夏日般的暖和周末。出门带伞，周末适合户外。
items.en_points: Afternoon showers today, then a summer-like warm weekend. Bring an umbrella; the weekend is good for being outdoors.

items.title: Man shot and wounded by ICE agents during operation in New York City while in car with 5-year-old
items.zh_title: 纽约ICE行动中男子中枪受伤
items.zh_points: 纽约市10月8日移民执法人员开枪打伤一名车内带5岁孩子的男子，现场有抗议。注意移民执法风险。
items.en_points: On Oct. 8 in NYC, immigration agents shot and wounded a man in a car with a 5-year-old; protests broke out at the scene. Be aware of enforcement risks.

items.title: Madison Art Commission showcases Teejop Community Art Project
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊展示Teejop社区艺术项目
items.zh_points: 七位艺术家创作作品纪念原住民历史和Ho-Chunk社区，Teejop意为“四湖”。想了解本地历史可去看看。
items.en_points: Seven artists made works honoring Indigenous history and the Ho-Chunk community; Teejop means 'four lakes.' Worth a visit to learn local history.

items.title: Hurricane Isaias shuts down nearly two-thirds of Gulf oil production; could affect gas prices
items.zh_title: 飓风致墨西哥湾产油停近三分之二
items.zh_points: 飓风不会直接影响威州，但能源设施受损后，中西部油价可能上涨。有车的同学留意加油开销。
items.en_points: The hurricane won't hit Wisconsin directly, but damaged energy facilities may push Midwest gas prices up. Students with cars should watch fuel costs.

items.title: Behind IceCube discoveries, decades of high-throughput computing
items.zh_title: IceCube诺奖背后的高通量计算
items.zh_points: UW和Morgridge研究所长期的计算支持，助力Halzen的IceCube研究，也参与过四项诺奖成果。
items.en_points: Long-term computing support from UW and the Morgridge Institute powered Halzen's IceCube research and also contributed to four Nobel-winning results.

items.title: Message From the Dean—October 2026
items.zh_title: 国际事务学院院长10月寄语
items.zh_points: 院长介绍Fill the Hill募捐，留学校友基金筹得超5000美元。偏校友动态，与日常学业关系不大。
items.en_points: The dean highlights the Fill the Hill fundraiser; the study abroad alumni fund raised over $5,000. Mostly alumni news, little bearing on coursework.

items.title: Tom Tiffany visits UW for a campus chat, discusses his campaign
items.zh_title: 州长候选人Tiffany到访UW校园座谈
items.zh_points: 共和党州长候选人Tiffany周三晚应校园共和党人社团邀请到Grainger Hall座谈。不允许录音，内容未经核实。
items.en_points: GOP gubernatorial candidate Tiffany spoke Wednesday night at Grainger Hall at a campus Republican group's invite. No recording allowed; content unverified.

items.title: Love and thanks: Yung Hae Chun’s lifelong pursuit of the piano
items.zh_title: Yung Hae Chun的钢琴人生
items.zh_points: 韩国裔学者Chun从战后用纸画键盘练琴，到如今家有三架三角钢琴。人物故事。
items.en_points: Korean-born scholar Chun went from practicing on a paper keyboard after the war to owning three grand pianos today. Profile.

items.title: UW–Madison’s METAL bootcamp inspires interest in metalworking for fun — and a stronger national future
items.zh_title: METAL金属加工训练营吸引参与者
items.zh_points: UW的四天金属加工训练营结合线上与线下教学。工程类同学若对金属加工感兴趣可关注。
items.en_points: UW's four-day metalworking bootcamp blends online and in-person teaching. Engineering students interested in metalworking may want to follow it.

items.title: Meet UW–Madison’s Nobel Prize winners
items.zh_title: 认识UW历届诺贝尔奖得主
items.zh_points: 回顾2026物理学奖得主Halzen及UW历代诺奖得主，他想在南极冰下建巨型望远镜。校园骄傲。
items.en_points: Profiles 2026 physics laureate Halzen and UW's past Nobel winners; he wants to build a giant telescope under Antarctic ice. Campus pride.

items.title: Recapping International Education Week 2026 at UW–Madison
items.zh_title: 2026国际教育周回顾
items.zh_points: 国际教育周举办了20多场活动，涵盖课堂、学生服务和公共场所。已结束，仅作回顾。
items.en_points: International Education Week held 20+ events across classrooms, student services and public spaces. Already over; recap only.

items.title: Connecting Badgers: AI and Mental Health Transcript
items.zh_title: UHS播客：AI聊天机器人与心理健康
items.zh_points: UHS心理健康提供者讨论用AI聊天机器人求助何时有用、何时有风险。播客文字稿。
items.en_points: UHS mental health providers discuss when turning to AI chatbots for support helps and when it's risky. Podcast transcript.

items.title: UW–Madison to implement 2027 compensation strategy
items.zh_title: UW公布2027年薪酬策略
items.zh_points: 学校批准1250万美元用于调薪，重点提高低薪员工。主要影响教职工，兼职学生员工可留意。
items.en_points: UW approved $12.5 million for pay raises, focused on lower-paid employees. Mainly affects faculty and staff; student employees may want to take note.

items.title: A statewide digital history hub, built by graduate students
items.zh_title: iSchool研究生共建全州数字历史库
items.zh_points: 信息学院研究生与Recollection Wisconsin合作，把威州各地方史数字化。
items.en_points: iSchool graduate students are working with Recollection Wisconsin to digitize local histories across the state.

items.title: (Per)Mission (Im)Possible
items.zh_title: 教务处：课程选课许可设置指南
items.zh_points: 面向教师的指南，说明如何为学生设置选课许可。需覆盖先修或容量限制时，可联系教师。
items.en_points: A guide for instructors on granting students enrollment permission. If you need to bypass a prerequisite or capacity limit, contact the instructor.

items.title: Connecting Badgers: Thrive Outside Transcript
items.zh_title: UHS播客：到户外获得好心情
items.zh_points: UHS介绍每天花10分钟接触自然就能改善心情，推荐去湖滨步道、Bascom Hill。
items.en_points: UHS says 10 minutes a day in nature can lift your mood, and suggests the Lakeshore Path and Bascom Hill.

items.title: Global Gateway Immerses Students in Korean History and Culture
items.zh_title: Global Gateway项目带学生走进韩国
items.zh_points: 韩语专业学生通过Global Gateway去韩国学习历史与文化，体验类故事。对短期海外项目感兴趣者可参考。
items.en_points: Korean majors went to Korea through Global Gateway to study its history and culture. A first-person story, useful if you're eyeing short-term programs abroad.

items.title: Staying on Top of Your Mental Health
items.zh_title: UWPD：留意自己的心理健康
items.zh_points: 社区警官提醒近一成美国人去年经历过心理危机，经历危机并不罕见，需要及时求助。
items.en_points: A community officer notes nearly 1 in 10 Americans had a mental health crisis last year; crises aren't rare, so seek help promptly.

items.title: Tasting the Difference: A Passion for Better Dairy
items.zh_title: 乳制品评委Verma的职业故事
items.zh_points: Pratishtha Verma担任国内外乳制品比赛评委，研究如何让乳制品更好。人物故事。
items.en_points: Pratishtha Verma judges dairy competitions in the US and abroad and studies how to make dairy better. Profile.

items.title: Global, Together: Q&A with Dean Vavrus
items.zh_title: “Global, Together”五年国际化框架问答
items.zh_points: 9月1日UW启动五年国际化框架，目标是增加学生机会、深化合作、拓展校友网络。
items.en_points: On Sept. 1 UW launched a five-year internationalization framework aimed at more student opportunities, deeper partnerships and a wider alumni network.

items.title: International Internships Prepare Badgers for the Global Workforce
items.zh_title: IAP国际实习项目介绍
items.zh_points: IAP提供多条国际实习路径，帮助学生积累技能和人脉。想海外实习的同学可咨询IAP。
items.en_points: IAP offers several international internship paths to build skills and networks. Students who want to intern abroad can consult IAP.

items.title: UW–Madison Announces Fulbright U.S. Student Awards for 2026-2027
items.zh_title: UW 16人获2026-27 Fulbright美国学生奖
items.zh_points: 16位Badger获奖，15人接受，将赴海外读研、研究或教英语。该项目面向美国公民。
items.en_points: 16 Badgers won awards and 15 accepted; they will go abroad for graduate study, research or English teaching. The program is for US citizens.

items.title: Safety Information & Resources
items.zh_title: UWPD：开学安全信息与资源
items.zh_points: UWPD提醒校内外都有犯罪风险，介绍预防、执法和受害者支持项目。建议收藏安全资源。
items.en_points: UWPD warns crime risks exist on and off campus and outlines its prevention, enforcement and victim support programs. Bookmark the safety resources.

items.title: Cheese-tasting course features rare Alpine cheeses from Switzerland
items.zh_title: 奶酪品鉴课推出瑞士阿尔卑斯稀有奶酪
items.zh_points: 品鉴样品包括一款用铜锅明火制作的奶酪，以及一款2024年世界奶酪锦标赛冠军奶酪。
items.en_points: A cheese-tasting course features rare Swiss Alpine cheeses, including one made over an open fire in copper kettles and a 2024 World Championship winner.

items.title: Monona Bakery & Eatery changing hands after 9 years
items.zh_title: Monona Bakery经营9年后易主
items.zh_points: 店主Vicente Sacramento和Claudia Santos将店铺及招牌配方交给另一家人经营。
items.en_points: Owners Vicente Sacramento and Claudia Santos are passing Monona Bakery & Eatery and its cherished recipes to a new family after nine years.

items.title: SBDC Built to Last: The Entrepreneur's Wellness Framework
items.zh_title: 小企业主抗压韧性五场系列课
items.zh_points: SBDC为小企业主开设五场课程，讲压力管理与长期韧性。主要面向创业者，普通学生可略过。
items.en_points: SBDC runs a five-session course for small business owners on stress management and long-term resilience. Aimed at entrepreneurs; most students can skip it.

items.title: 7 Lifesaving Furniture Safety Tips
items.zh_title: 七条家具安全提示
items.zh_points: 买家具时除了款式舒适也要考虑安全，文章列出七条建议。买二手家具的同学可参考。
items.en_points: When buying furniture, weigh safety along with style and comfort; the article lists seven tips. Useful if you're buying used furniture.

items.title: The five evil things doomed to happen on a night out
items.zh_title: 幽默稿：夜出必遇的五件倒霉事
items.zh_points: Badger Herald搞笑专栏，调侃夜出常见糟心事。纯娱乐。
items.en_points: Badger Herald humor column poking fun at common night-out mishaps. Pure entertainment.

items.title: Local activism proves crucial in protecting Wisconsin’s natural beauty
items.zh_title: 评论：威州西南居民抵制高压输电线
items.zh_points: 西南部居民跨党派反对765千伏输电线穿过农田，作者支持本地行动。观点文章。
items.en_points: Southwest Wisconsin residents across party lines oppose a 765 kV power line through farmland; the author backs local action. Opinion piece.

items.title: Five excuses to have at the ready upon walking into class late
items.zh_title: 幽默稿：上课迟到的五个借口
items.zh_points: Badger Herald搞笑专栏，调侃迟到借口。纯娱乐。
items.en_points: Badger Herald humor column poking fun at excuses for showing up late. Pure entertainment.

items.title: 10 years later, “Moonlight” remains a masterpiece
items.zh_title: 《月光男孩》十周年重映影评
items.zh_points: 影片10月2日起限时重映，评论称其仍是杰作。想看电影的同学可留意影院场次。
items.en_points: The film returns for a limited run from Oct. 2, and the review calls it still a masterpiece. Check theater showtimes if interested.

items.title: Wisconsin needs to get serious about Line 5
items.zh_title: 评论：威州应认真对待Line 5管道
items.zh_points: Enbridge Line 5管道破裂泄漏130万加仑液化天然气，为威州最大泄漏事故，未造成环境或人员伤害。观点文章。
items.en_points: Enbridge's Line 5 ruptured and leaked 1.3 million gallons of liquefied natural gas, Wisconsin's largest spill, with no harm to people or the environment. Opinion.

items.title: Hessen delegation visit marks 50 years of Wisconsin–Hessen partnership
items.zh_title: 德国黑森州代表团访威州，伙伴关系50周年
items.zh_points: 黑森州代表团8月访问，庆祝与威州结好50年并探讨学术科研合作。偏官方交流。
items.en_points: A Hessen delegation visited in August to mark 50 years of partnership with Wisconsin and explore academic and research ties. Mostly an official exchange.

items.title: In our Accessibility Era: New GA Room Tables
items.zh_title: 教务处：教室信息改为网页表格
items.zh_points: 通用教室的PDF清单改为可搜索、可筛选的网页表格，显示容量和设备。
items.en_points: The PDF list of general assignment classrooms is now a searchable, filterable web table showing capacity and equipment.
